e1.titre: Someone is looking out for your class
e1.p1: Sometimes, a person from the academy watches and listens to your class live.
e1.p2: They come to check that everything is going well and that your teacher is kind and doing their job well.
e1.p3: They do not speak. They do not film. They do not show your class to anyone.
e1.p4: You do not know when they come. That is normal: this way, they see the real class. The little message at the top of the screen reminds you.
e1.p5: If something bothers you or scares you during a class, tell your parents.

e2.p1: To protect students, a person from the academy may observe a class live, without warning of the time. They see the class screen and can hear the sound.
e2.p2: They do not speak, have no camera and record nothing. They write a short report for the academy's administration, mainly about the teacher and how the class went. Your first name appears in it only if necessary.
e2.p3: This report is never published and is deleted after 12 months. It is used only by the academy to make the right decisions.
e2.p4: The banner at the top of the room reminds you that a visit is possible. If you have a question, or if something bothers you, talk to your parents or write to {contact}.

releve.adulte: During a session, the app notes whether the teacher's connection and that of each adult student are good, weak or lost, and whether their microphone is open at that moment. It keeps neither the sound nor the image, nor the connection address. For a minor student, it keeps nothing. This log is used to understand what happened when a session is disputed. It is kept for 180 days, then deleted. Only the management can read it. You can ask the management for the data about you, and object to this log.
releve.mineur: During a session, the app notes whether your teacher's connection is good, weak or lost, and whether their microphone is open at that moment. It keeps neither the sound nor the image. About your own connection, it keeps nothing. This log is kept for 180 days, then deleted. Only the management can read it.
releve.guidee: During class, the app checks whether your connection is working well. It keeps neither your voice nor your image, and it keeps nothing about your connection.

codeConduite.intro: These rules protect students, and they protect you. Read them, then accept.
regles: Your classes are held in the academy's room. A class may be audio-recorded, and a person in charge of review may follow it live without telling you when. A parent may also attend the class for a limited time, to see how the session goes: you are informed. You accept these measures: they protect children and they protect you.
You see your students' first names. Their full name is not shown, to keep the screen short. You never see a family's contact details: no email, no phone.
What you know about a child stays with the academy, to protect their personal data. You do not make it public and you do not show it to other families.
You never contact a student or their family privately, outside the app.
In front of the camera, your dress is appropriate and the background behind you is neutral and calm.
You are on time. You open the room before the class starts.
You are also callers to the faith: be exemplary in your words and gestures, and patient with each student.
If a child's safety worries you, report it right away with "Report a need", category "A child's safety". The management reads it first.
If you refuse these rules, the academy cannot entrust students to you, because they protect children.

contrat.pointEnregistrement: A class may be recorded in audio. In that case, it is kept for thirty days, then erased. Each listening is entered in the log, with the name of the person listening.
contrat.pointControle: A quality reviewer may attend a class without being seen. The room reminds of this permanently, whether the visit takes place or not.
contrat.pointCoordonnees: You shall never see a family's contact details: neither full name, nor email, nor phone.

a3.quoi: A class may be recorded in audio. The image is not recorded. A person from the Academy in charge of review may also follow a class live: they see and hear the class, without being seen or heard. They record nothing. The room reminds of this permanently.
a3.pourquoi: To protect children and Teachers. If someone reports a problem, we can check what happened.

a3.qui: Only the persons of the Academy in charge of quality and protection, and only for a specific reason, for example a report. Each listening is entered in a log. You may ask whether a recording has been listened to, and why.
a3.duree: {duree} days, then erased. If there is a report, the recording is kept until the end of the review.
a3.desaccord: You may object: Account, My agreements, I object to recording. We shall reply within one month. We shall look for a solution with you. If none is possible, you may stop at no cost for the classes not yet attended.

e1.pourquoi: To protect children and Teachers. If someone reports a problem, we can check what happened. It is also evidence for you if a family complains wrongly.
e1.refus: We cannot entrust students to you, because this measure protects children. We tell you before your signature.

clauseControle.texte: To protect students and guarantee the quality of classes, a person from the Academy may observe your classes live, without warning you of the time. They see and hear the class. They do not speak, record nothing and publish nothing. They write a report for the administration. You receive a summary each month. You may dispute it. Reports are kept for 12 months. The review policy, attached to this contract and available in your space, explains everything. By signing, you confirm having received it.
clauseControle.caseReligion: I agree that the Academy processes the fact that I teach the Quran, which may reveal my religion, to manage my contract and my classes.

blocs: Our Teachers and our students live in many countries. We verify the identity and background of each Teacher, but no verification tells everything. We entrust children to adults, online, often alone. Parents must be able to trust us.
Review visits serve four purposes:
1. to protect the students;
2. to verify that the class respects our teaching objectives and our safety rules;
3. to enable the administration to act if there is a problem;
4. to help you improve.
They serve no other purpose. They are not used to calculate your pay. No decision is made by a machine: a person from the administration always decides.
- A person from the Academy, called a reviewer, is **approved by the administration** and signs in with **two-step verification** (B1, B2).
- The system chooses a Class **at random**. A Class may be visited several times in the month, or not at all. A reviewer never observes their own Class or a session in which they take part.
- You are **not told when** the visit takes place. You are told **in advance that it may take place**: by this text, by your contract and by the room's permanent banner "review visit possible".
- The reviewer sees the document, your video and the students' thumbnails. They may hear the sound. They have **no microphone, no camera and no chat**. They cannot speak to you or to the students.
- They **record nothing**. Screen capture is blocked on their device (B10).
- The administration may withdraw their access **in one click** (B3).
- **An automatic log of the session**: planned time, actual time, length, students present, reconnections. No one enters it by hand.
- **The reviewer's report**: "Nothing to report", or an observation on the class (nature, area, person concerned, text). They write only what they observed about the class.
- The report is **never rewritten**. An addendum may be added, dated.
- The reviewer's draft **never leaves the app** and is erased after sending (B11).
- **The raw report**: the administration, and the reviewer who wrote it, for their own report only (B13).
- **The export**: the administration only, and each export is noted in the log (B14).
- **You**: a **monthly summary** with the positive points and the points to follow up.
- **The reviewer's name is never given to you**, even after the summary (B15). This protects them from pressure. You receive all the content that concerns you: this is what allows you to respond.
- **No one else.** Nothing is published, nor shown to families, nor to other Teachers.
- The raw report is kept **12 months** after it is sent, then erased. If there is a file or a measure in progress, it is kept until the end of that file (B4).
- The monthly summary, without any student's name, is kept longer to follow your progress. Length: that of your contract, plus 12 months.
- You may dispute **once per report**.
- You have **7 days** from the day you receive the monthly summary.
- You write **the reason**. Without a written reason, the request is not processed.
- The administration reviews and replies to you in writing. The report is not rewritten; your dispute and the administration's decision are added to it.
This dispute is an internal procedure. **It removes none of your legal rights** (part 8), which you may exercise at any time, even after 7 days.

On the basis of a report, the administration may: congratulate you, offer you training, ask you to change a practice, withdraw a Class from you, or end the contract in serious cases. Any measure is decided by a person, after reading, and is explained to you. In case of danger to a child, the Academy may act immediately and notify the authorities of the country.

- **Access**: you may ask for a copy of your data, including the reports that concern you. We reply within one month. The reviewer's name and the students' data are masked (DPA 2018, Schedule 2, Part 3, paragraph 16: third-party data).
- **Rectification**: if a fact is wrong (time, attendance), we correct it.

- **Objection**: you may object to the review. We examine your request. As the review protects children, we may maintain it. In that case, we cannot entrust you with a children's Class, and we tell you in writing.
- **Complaint**: you may refer the matter to the data protection authority (in the United Kingdom, the ICO; in the EU, the authority of your country).

Legitimate interest of the Academy and of the students: protecting children and guaranteeing the quality of classes (UK GDPR art. 6(1)(f)). The balancing test is written and signed. We do not ask for your "consent" to the review, because you could not freely refuse it.

questionnaire.moyenValide: You receive your pay through a method approved by Rewayah.
questionnaire.continuite: By accepting these terms, you commit to holding your class on the same days and at the same times, every week.
questionnaire.plagesChevauchent: Your availability overlaps on the same day. Review it, then send your application again.

p1.intro: Before the questions, here is what you need to know about us.

academie.texte: Rewayah Academy teaches the Quran remotely, in stable classes, with a dedicated teacher. It has been teaching since 1 May 2024.

liberte.texte: As long as you are not a teacher, you can withdraw your application from your file.

donnees.texte: Your answers are only read by the people at the academy who review your application.

separation.texte: A woman's application is followed by the management on the women's side, a man's application on the men's side.

p2.intro: You teach by video, in a class that stays the same.

classe.texte: You keep the same class over time, with the same students.

horaires.texte: Your class meets on the same days and at the same times, three times a week.

visio.texte: Classes are given by video conference, in the Rewayah app.

remuneration.texte: Your pay is a share of the price each student present pays. It is explained to you as a percentage before you send your application.

examen.texte: You answer the questions, read and accept our agreements, upload your photo and your ID document, then send your application. The management reads it.

entretien.titre: Let's get to know each other
entretien.texte: If your application is accepted, you choose a slot and the management meets you by video, in the app.

verification.texte: When everything is in order, you join the academy's team of teachers, in the app.

langues.autreDescription: A language that is not in the list. The management will see it.
langues.dansReferentiel: Rewayah offers classes in this language.
langues.horsReferentiel: Rewayah does not yet offer classes in this language. You can choose it: the management will see it.

fuseau.oui: Yes, that is my local time
fuseau.changer: No, I want to change it
fuseau.changerDescription: You choose the city closest to you.
fuseau.choisirTitre: Which city is closest to you?
fuseau.choisirExplication: It gives your time zone. The times of your interview will be shown in this time zone.
fuseau.ouiExplication: Your availability and your interview will be in your local time.
fuseau.changerExplication: Useful if you travel or if your device's time is wrong.

creneaux.raccourcisAide: A shortcut chooses several days at once. You can then add or remove some.

moinsDeTrois(param=n).one: You chose a single day. A class meets three times a week, on the same days: consider choosing at least three.
moinsDeTrois(param=n).other: You chose {n} days. A class meets three times a week, on the same days: consider choosing at least three.

creneaux.troisSeances: A class meets three times a week, on the same days and at the same time.
creneaux.durees: A children's class lasts {enfants}, an adults' class lasts {adultes}.

versement.virementSeul: In your country, the academy has confirmed bank transfer. No mobile payment method is offered for now.
versement.aucunMoyen: Rewayah does not yet pay teachers in this country. You can send your application: it will stay on hold until a method becomes possible.
versement.chargement: We are looking for the methods possible in your country.
versement.nonCharge: The payment methods for your country could not be loaded.
versement.operateurExplication: You declare it now. Your details are only requested before your first payment.

recap.explication: Tap an answer to change it. Nothing is sent before the "Send my application" button.

langueMaternelle.explication: It is the language you have spoken since childhood. This question is optional: you can continue without answering.

languesExplication.titre: In which languages can you explain and correct?
languesExplication.explication: Choose all the languages in which you can explain a rule to a student and correct their mistakes, with no limit on the number. The student or their parent chooses their language at sign-up, and the academy assigns them a teacher who speaks it: the more you speak, the more you can teach. Arabic is not a class language: it is not in this list.

niveauMemorisationDeclare.titre: How much of the Quran have you memorised?
niveauMemorisationDeclare.explication: You declare it here. Having memorised and having an ijaza are two different things: the ijaza is asked a little further on.

aucune.libelle: I have not memorised a whole juz
aucune.description: You may know a few surahs, but not a whole juz.
aucune.explication: This level is assessed during the interview.
aucune.exemple: you recite a few short surahs from memory, but not a whole juz.

moins_10_juz.libelle: I have memorised fewer than 10 juz
moins_10_juz.description: From one whole juz to nine juz, out of the thirty of the Quran.
moins_10_juz.explication: This level is assessed during the interview.
moins_10_juz.exemple: you have memorised five juz out of thirty.

de_10_a_29_juz.description: From a third of the Quran to almost all of it.
de_10_a_29_juz.explication: This level is assessed during the interview.
de_10_a_29_juz.exemple: you have memorised twenty juz out of thirty.

coran_entier.libelle: I have memorised the whole Quran
coran_entier.description: All 114 surahs, from the first to the last, by heart.
coran_entier.explication: This level is assessed during the interview.
coran_entier.exemple: you recite Al-Baqara, then An-Nas, without opening the book.

niveauLectureTajwid.titre: How do you read the Quran?
niveauLectureTajwid.explication: Tajwid is the set of rules that say how to pronounce each letter of the Quran.

lecture_sans_regles_tajwid.libelle: I read without applying the tajwid rules
lecture_sans_regles_tajwid.description: You read fluently, without following the pronunciation rules.
lecture_sans_regles_tajwid.explication: Your reading is assessed during the interview.
lecture_sans_regles_tajwid.exemple: you read a page without hesitating, but you do not apply the tajwid rules.

tajwid_applique.libelle: I apply the tajwid rules when reading
tajwid_applique.description: You follow the pronunciation rules when you read.
tajwid_applique.explication: Your reading is assessed during the interview.
tajwid_applique.exemple: you lengthen and pronounce letters as the tajwid rules require.

tajwid_enseigne.libelle: I apply tajwid and I can teach it
tajwid_enseigne.description: You follow the rules and can explain them to a student.
tajwid_enseigne.explication: Your reading is assessed during the interview.
tajwid_enseigne.exemple: when a student makes a mistake on a letter, you explain the rule and they repeat it.

riwayat.explication: A riwaya is a transmitted way of reciting the Quran. Choose all those you recite.

ishaq.description: Transmitted from Khalaf, the tenth reciter

idris.description: Transmitted from Khalaf, the tenth reciter

ijazaPresentable.explication: An ijaza is a written authorisation, given by a teacher, to transmit the Quran. Whoever has an ijaza has memorised, but whoever has memorised does not necessarily have an ijaza: it is a separate question.

oui.libelle: Yes, I have an ijaza to present
oui.description: You can show it by video.
oui.explication: It is shown during the interview: you have nothing to send now.
oui.exemple: a document signed by your teacher, which you keep at home.

pret_test.libelle: No ijaza, but I can take a test
pret_test.description: You have no ijaza to present, but you agree to take a test.
pret_test.explication: The academy will discuss it with you during the interview.
pret_test.exemple: you learned with a teacher without a written document, and you agree to be tested.

non.libelle: No, I do not have an ijaza
non.description: You have no ijaza, and you do not plan to take a test for now.
non.explication: Your level is then assessed during the interview.
non.exemple: you learned with a teacher, without receiving a written document.

experienceDebutants.explication: A beginner is still learning to read the letters and join them.

oui.libelle: Yes, I have already taught beginners
oui.description: You have already guided students who are just starting.
oui.explication: The management knows before the interview.
oui.exemple: you taught the Arabic letters to children or to adults.

non.description: You have not yet taught beginners.
non.explication: You can still send your application.
non.exemple: you have only taught students who already knew how to read.

fuseauIana.explication: Your availability is in your local time. So the time must be right.

disponibilitesDeclarees.explication: A class meets three times a week, on the same days and at the same time. Tap the days you can teach, or use a shortcut.

heures.titre: At what time can you start, on {jour}?
heures.explication: Choose all the times at which you can start a class. The end of the class is calculated for you.
heures.suite: You will then say whether it is the same on the other days.

memes.titre: Are these the same times for all these days?
memes.explication: You chose {jours}. On {premier}, you start at {heures}.

oui.description: The times for {premier} also apply to {autres}.
oui.explication: You can change a day before sending your application.
oui.exemple: you can start at 6 pm on Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

non.description: You set the times for each day, one after the other.
non.explication: The times already chosen stay: you adjust them.
non.exemple: you start at 6 pm on Monday, but at 8 pm on Wednesday.

parJour.titre: Set the times, day by day
parJour.explication: Each day starts from the times already chosen. Add or remove times where it is not the same.

semaine.explication: Here is when you can teach, in your local time. Review it, then continue.

classesSouhaitees.titre: How many classes do you want to hold?
classesSouhaitees.explication: A class is a group of students who meet three times a week, on the same days and at the same time, with the same teacher. It is a wish: the academy decides which classes it assigns to you.

debutPossible.explication: This date helps the management know when to offer you a class.

immediat.description: You can start as soon as a class is assigned to you.
immediat.exemple: no commitment holds you back this month.

mois_prochain.description: You will be available from next month.
mois_prochain.exemple: you finish another job at the end of this month.

sous_3_mois.description: You will be available within the next three months.
sous_3_mois.exemple: you are travelling or sitting exams for a few weeks.

inconnu.description: You do not yet know your start date.
inconnu.explication: You can tell the management during the interview.
inconnu.exemple: your schedule depends on an answer you are still waiting for.

publics.explication: Choose the age groups you are comfortable teaching. There is no wrong answer: you can choose just one, or several.

o_6_9.description: They start with Rewayah's reading book, letter by letter, up to the shadda. Then come the first short surahs, the words of the prayer and the ablutions.
o_6_9.explication: Classes of 5 children at most (4 for beginners), three one-hour sessions per week. The ablutions and the prayer are shown in practice, with illustrations.
o_6_9.exemple: a class of eight-year-olds, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

o_10_13.description: Same start with the reading book, and Al-Fatiha from the first week, because at this age the child must pray.
o_10_13.explication: Classes of 5 children at most (4 for beginners), three one-hour sessions per week.
o_10_13.exemple: a class of twelve-year-olds, three times a week.

o_14_17.description: The same content as for ages 10 to 13: the reading book, and Al-Fatiha from the first week.
o_14_17.explication: Classes of 5 teenagers at most (4 for beginners), three one-hour sessions per week.
o_14_17.exemple: a class of sixteen-year-olds, three times a week.

adultes.description: Adults first learn to read with Rewayah's book. After the basics, the student chooses to read the whole Quran or to memorise it, on the teacher's advice.
adultes.explication: Classes of 6 adults at most (4 for beginners), three sessions of an hour and a half per week. Adult classes are separate: women with women, men with men.
adultes.exemple: a women's class, or a men's class, three times a week.

paysResidence.titre: Which country do you live in?
paysResidence.explication: Choose the country where you live today.

paysVersement.titre: In which country do you want to receive your pay?
paysVersement.explication: The academy checks, country by country, which payment method is possible. We carried over your country of residence: change it if needed.

compteBancaire.titre: Do you have a bank account to receive your payment, in your name or a relative's?
compteBancaire.explication: Pay is paid by bank transfer where the academy has confirmed it. Your details are only requested before the first payment.

oui.libelle: Yes, in my name or a relative's
oui.description: An account at a bank, in your name or a relative's.
oui.explication: Bank transfer can be your payment method, if the academy has confirmed it in your country.
oui.exemple: an account opened at a bank, in your brother's name.

non.description: Neither in your name, nor in a relative's.
non.explication: You can then choose a mobile payment method, if there is one in your country.
non.exemple: you only receive and send money with your phone.

operateurs.titre: Which mobile payment methods do you use?
operateurs.explication: Here are the methods the academy has confirmed in your country. Choose those you use, if any.

moyensAccessibles.titre: Which payment methods are common where you live?
moyensAccessibles.explication: Here are the methods the academy knows. Choose those that are common in your country, if any.

classes.heuresEnfants: That is {heures} per week with children.
classes.heuresAdultes: That is {heures} per week with adults.
classes.heuresLesDeux: That is {enfants} per week with children, or {adultes} with adults.
classes.explication: Each class has its own schedule, which it keeps every week.
classes.exemple1: on Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 6 pm.
classes.exemple2: on Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 6 pm, then on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday at 7 pm.

exemplePlusieurs(param=n).other: {n} classes, each with its days and its time.

moyens.explication: Choose it if it is common where you live.
moyens.nonElimine: This question is optional and eliminates no one: your application does not depend on your answer. It helps the academy know the methods used where you live.

parcours.choisirJour: Choose at least one day to continue.
parcours.choisirHeure: Choose at least one start time to continue.

tuile.facultatif: Optional. This changes nothing about your teacher application.
tuile.enregistre: Your answers are saved. You can edit them.
tuile.enregistreClose: Your answers are saved. You can withdraw them.

intro.texte: The academy is growing. It will need help to organize itself, support families, keep its accounts or make itself known. If you can do something else, tell us: we will contact you first, before posting an announcement.

facultatif.texte: This changes nothing about your teacher application.

usage.texte: Your answers are used only to offer you an academy mission. The management reads them, and only the management.

liberte.texte: You can edit or withdraw your answers whenever you want, and withdraw the agreement that allows us to contact you.

missions.texte: The academy presents them to you when it contacts you. This page promises no mission.

competences.explication: Tap all the skills you have. Each card gives an example. If yours is not there, choose "Other area" at the bottom of the list.
competences.nonProposee: This skill is no longer offered. You can keep it or untick it.
competences.autreChamp: Your area, in a few words
competences.manque: Choose at least one skill to continue.
competences.autreVide: Say in a few words which area it is, or untick "Other area".
competences.autreTropLong: Your text is too long: {max} characters at most. Shorten it.

reseaux_sociaux.description: Run the academy's social media accounts.
reseaux_sociaux.exemple: Post every week, answer messages and comments

relations_publiques.description: Make the academy known to those who can support it.
relations_publiques.exemple: Present the academy to a mosque, an association or a media outlet

design_graphique.exemple: A poster, a card to share, a visual for social media

montage_video.exemple: Cut a video, add subtitles, animate a title

photographie.description: Take quality photos, videos or sound recordings.
photographie.exemple: Photograph an event, record a short presentation

redaction_contenus.description: Write accurate texts that are pleasant to read.
redaction_contenus.exemple: An article, a text for social media, a newsletter

publicite_en_ligne.description: Prepare and follow advertising campaigns on the internet.
publicite_en_ligne.exemple: Choose the target audience, launch a campaign, follow the results

traduction.description: Translate texts from one language to another.
traduction.exemple: Messages to families, subtitles, a text for the website

assistanat.description: Help the management organize day to day.
assistanat.exemple: Keep a diary, write letters, follow files

coordination_groupe.description: Run and support a community of people, for example the sisters' or the parents'.
coordination_groupe.exemple: Welcome newcomers, answer questions, circulate information

accueil_familles.description: Be the first contact for families who sign up.
accueil_familles.exemple: Answer a question, support a registration, check in

gestion_projet.description: Organize teamwork from start to finish.
gestion_projet.exemple: Draw up a schedule, share out tasks, follow progress

ressources_humaines.description: Choose and welcome the people who join the team.
ressources_humaines.exemple: Conduct an interview, compare applications, welcome a new teacher

comptabilite.exemple: Record invoices, follow payments, prepare a balance sheet

gestion_financiere.description: Follow the money and prepare decisions.
gestion_financiere.exemple: Build a budget, follow cash flow

juridique_donnees.description: Make sure the academy complies with the law and protects personal data.
juridique_donnees.exemple: Review a contract, write terms of use, protect privacy

conception_programmes.description: Prepare what students learn, and the materials to teach it.
conception_programmes.exemple: A lesson plan, a worksheet, a series of exercises

formation_enseignants.exemple: Train a new teacher, advise them after a session

qualite_cours.description: Observe sessions and help improve them.
qualite_cours.exemple: Attend a session, give written feedback

tests_niveau.exemple: Listen to a new student recite before they join a class

accompagnement_enfants.description: Help children who need particular attention.
accompagnement_enfants.exemple: Child psychology, special needs, very shy children

developpement.exemple: A website, an app, an internal tool

assistance_technique.libelle: Technical support for families and teachers
assistance_technique.description: Troubleshoot remotely for people with a technical problem.
assistance_technique.exemple: Help sign in, adjust the sound or the camera

donnees_tableurs.description: Organize figures and turn them into clear tables.
donnees_tableurs.exemple: A tracking table, statistics, a report

autre.description: A skill that is not in the list.

pas_maintenant.description: You just want the academy to know your talents.

partage.regleJamaisAide: Choose this when their family must not see them automatically: they are hidden right away, the notebook is kept.
partage.consequenceEleve: This rule concerns only this student. It changes neither the class nor the other students.
partage.consequenceEleveJamais: Reports visible through automatic sharing are hidden right away from their family. The notebook and the session proof are kept.
partage.aucunCompteRendu: No report exists yet for this student.
partage.apercuTitre: Preview of the report visible to the family
partage.apercuAide: What the family will read, in the same order and with the same headings as in the app.
partage.notesInternes: The notebook's internal notes are never shown here.
partage.etatNonValide: The notebook is not validated yet. No publication is possible.
partage.etatConfirmeNonPartage: Notebook validated, report not shared with the family.
partage.etatRevoque: Family access revoked for this report.
partage.etatCorrige: Corrected after publication: the family sees the latest approved version.
partage.nonPubliable: No shareable teaching content exists for this report: publication is not possible.
partage.portee: This action concerns only this report.
partage.consequencePublier: Sharing is limited to this report. It does not turn on the class's automatic sharing.
partage.confirmerRevoquer: Revoke the family's access to this report?
partage.consequenceRevoquer: The family no longer sees it, right away. The notebook and the session stay validated.
partage.publie: This report is now visible to the family.
partage.revoque: Access to this report has been revoked.
partage.conflitApercu: Another member of the management changed this report. The up-to-date state is shown.

formulaire.contexte: A class brings together a teacher and their students on the same slot each week. Choose the audience and the gender: the teachers list, the ceiling and the class name follow from them.
formulaire.publicEnfantDetail: Choose for a children's class. Suggested ceiling: 5 students.
formulaire.publicAdulteDetail: Choose for an adults' class. Suggested ceiling: 6 students.
formulaire.genreHommesDetail: Choose for a men's class: only male teachers will be able to take it.
formulaire.genreFemmesDetail: Choose for a women's class: only female teachers will be able to take it.
formulaire.genreGarconsDetail: Choose for a boys' class: only male teachers will be able to take it.
formulaire.genreFillesDetail: Choose for a girls' class: only female teachers will be able to take it.
formulaire.genreIndetermineDetail: Choose when the gender is not yet known: any teacher whose gender is filled in will be able to take it.
formulaire.autresCreneauxContexte: A class meets three times a week by default, on fixed days. Remove a line for a class that meets less often; no date to enter.
formulaire.manqueAutreCreneau: Choose the day and time of slot {n}, or remove it.
formulaire.creneauEnDouble: Two slots fall on the same day at the same time: change one.
formulaire.dureeContexte: By default, a slot lasts the class's length, set by its audience. Choose another length for this slot only.
formulaire.genreMixteDetailEnfants: Boys and girls together: any teacher whose gender is filled in will be able to take it. Choose only when teachers of one gender are missing.
formulaire.genreMixteDetailAdultes: Men and women together: any teacher whose gender is filled in will be able to take it. Choose only when teachers of one gender are missing.
formulaire.genreHommesDetailSansSource: Choose for a men's class. Teachers' gender is not yet readable here: check yourself that the teacher chosen is a man.
formulaire.genreFemmesDetailSansSource: Choose for a women's class. Teachers' gender is not yet readable here: check yourself that you choose a woman teacher.
formulaire.genreGarconsDetailSansSource: Choose for a boys' class. Teachers' gender is not yet readable here: check yourself that the teacher chosen is a man.
formulaire.genreFillesDetailSansSource: Choose for a girls' class. Teachers' gender is not yet readable here: check yourself that you choose a woman teacher.
formulaire.genreNonEnregistre: The gender guides the choice of teacher. It will be saved with the class as soon as the server accepts it: for now, it is not.
formulaire.aideEnseignant: Teachers are ranked from most to least suitable: class gender, free slot, then fewest classes in progress.
formulaire.aideEnseignantSansSource: Teachers are ranked from least to most loaded, and a teacher already in class at this slot cannot be chosen. Their gender and availability are not yet readable here: check them yourself.
formulaire.plusAdapteCreneau: First choice: free at this slot, {charge}.
formulaire.pasLibre: This slot is not in their declared availability: you can still make this choice.
formulaire.raisonHommes: Men's class: only a male teacher can take it.
formulaire.raisonGarcons: Boys' class: only a male teacher can take it.
formulaire.raisonFemmes: Women's class: only a female teacher can take it.
formulaire.raisonFilles: Girls' class: only a female teacher can take it.
formulaire.raisonPris: Already in class at this slot: change the slot to choose them.
formulaire.raisonGenreInconnu: Gender not filled in on their profile: no class can be entrusted to them until it is.
formulaire.creneauContexte: The day and time of the class, each week.
formulaire.creneauxLibresDe: {deNom}'s free slots: tapping a slot sets the day and time.
formulaire.aucunCreneauLibre: {nom} has no free slot declared: choose a day and a time below.
formulaire.disponibilitesInconnues: {deNom}'s availability is not yet readable here: choose a day and a time below.
formulaire.fuseauEnseignant: Times read in the {fuseau} time zone, the teacher's.
formulaire.fuseauDefaut: Times read in the {fuseau} time zone, kept by default.
formulaire.fuseauNonTransmis: Times read in the {fuseau} time zone, the one the server keeps for now. The teacher's time zone will be taken into account as soon as the server accepts it.
formulaire.seuilDetail: The class is full as soon as it reaches this number of students. Suggested: 5 for children, 6 for adults; 6 at most.
formulaire.nomAutomatique: The class name is chosen automatically from names of personalities of Islam: a woman's name for a women's class, a man's name for a men's class. You will be able to change it afterwards.
formulaire.manqueGenre: The class gender is missing: choose one of the three cards.
formulaire.manqueCreneau: The slot is missing: choose the day and time of the class.
formulaire.manqueSeuil: The maximum ceiling is missing: choose a number of students between 1 and 6.
formulaire.manqueEnseignantHommes: {nom} cannot take a men's class: choose a male teacher from the list.
formulaire.manqueEnseignantGarcons: {nom} cannot take a boys' class: choose a male teacher from the list.
formulaire.manqueEnseignantFemmes: {nom} cannot take a women's class: choose a female teacher from the list.
formulaire.manqueEnseignantFilles: {nom} cannot take a girls' class: choose a female teacher from the list.
formulaire.manqueEnseignantPris: {nom} is already in class at this slot: change the slot or choose another person from the list.
formulaire.manqueEnseignantGenreInconnu: {nom} has no gender filled in on their profile: no class can be entrusted to them. Choose another person from the list.
formulaire.manqueListeEnseignants: The teachers list is not up to date yet, so the teacher chosen could not be checked: wait for it to display, then press again.
formulaire.horsLigne: The class can be created when the connection has returned. Your choices stay displayed.
formulaire.seuilHorsLigne: The ceiling can be saved when the connection has returned. Your choice stays displayed.

offres.sousTitre: The slots families see and choose. Only the administration publishes, and the showcase shows no teacher.
offres.vide: No offer yet. Create the first one to open the showcase to families.
offres.erreur: The offers could not be displayed: the read may not have reached Rewayah. Try again in a moment.
offres.sansDonnees: The offers could not be loaded
offres.horsLigneAction: Publishing and withdrawing an offer will be possible when the connection has returned.
offres.publiee: Offer published. Families see it in the showcase.
offres.creee: Offer created as a draft. Publish it to open it to families.
offres.nonConfirmee: The action could not be confirmed: nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
offres.retraitExplication: Requests already made on this offer are kept: the administration must handle them.

serveur.reserve: Only the administration can manage offers.
serveur.motifRequis: A reason is required to withdraw an offer.
serveur.joursInvalides: The chosen days are not valid.
serveur.nombreJours: The number of days does not match the academy's sessions per week.

offres.retraitHorsLigne: The offer can be withdrawn when the connection has returned. Your reason stays displayed.

formulaire.question: Which slot to open to families?
formulaire.explication: A published offer cannot be changed: to change it, withdraw it then create another. No teacher is chosen here.
formulaire.horsLigne: The offer can be created when the connection has returned. Your choices stay displayed.
formulaire.regles: The academy's rules could not be read: the number of days will be checked on sending.

regroupements.sousTitre: Requests from families that look alike are grouped: same days, same time, same time zone, same audience, same language.
regroupements.tri: Requests ready to open a class first, then the most numerous.
regroupements.indisponibleTitre: Available once the server is connected
regroupements.indisponiblePhrase: Grouped requests will be shown here once the server is connected. Until then, nothing is shown: no request is invented.
regroupements.erreur: The grouped requests could not be displayed: the read may not have reached Rewayah. Try again in a moment.
regroupements.sansDonnees: The grouped requests could not be loaded
regroupements.videDetail: New family requests will appear here, grouped when they look alike.
regroupements.pretDetail: The quota is reached: the class can open full.

manquent.one: {n} request is missing to reach the quota: the class can be created as soon as the grouping is ready.
manquent.other: {n} requests are missing to reach the quota: the class can be created as soon as the grouping is ready.

regroupements.nonOuvert: Creating this class is not open to you: a member of the management who has the right can do it.
regroupements.affectationNonOuverte: Confirming the teacher is not open to you: a member of the management who has the right can do it.
regroupements.classeAttend: Class {libelle} created: its teacher is still to be confirmed.

contexte.one: The student of these requests will be placed in the class as soon as it is created. You will then confirm the proposed teacher.
contexte.other: The {n} students of these requests will be placed in the class as soon as it is created. You will then confirm the proposed teacher.

regroupements.nomDetail: Deduced from the gender, audience, days and time.
regroupements.dejaCreee: Another member of the management has just created this class: nothing was created twice. Close this sheet to see the up-to-date list.
regroupements.refusee: The class was not created: {motif}. Check the requests, then press again.
regroupements.nonConfirmee: The creation is not confirmed: the server's answer did not arrive. Press again: the same request will be resumed, with no duplicate class.
regroupements.enseignantContexte: The first choice takes into account the class's gender, their free slots on the same days and at the same time, then the number of their classes. These times are compared as they are, with no time zone conversion: if the teacher lives in another time zone, check with them before confirming. Confirm them or choose another person.
regroupements.enseignantHorsLigne: The teacher can be confirmed when the connection has returned. Your choice stays displayed.
regroupements.affectationNonConfirmee: The teacher is not confirmed: the server's answer did not arrive. Press again.

refusAffectation.reservee: The teacher is not confirmed: your account is not allowed to confirm a teacher.
refusAffectation.classeIndisponible: The teacher is not confirmed: this class no longer awaits a teacher. Close this sheet to see the up-to-date list.
refusAffectation.enseignantIndisponible: The teacher is not confirmed: their account, ID document, course language or gender filled in do not yet allow this class. Choose another person.
refusAffectation.genreIncompatible: The teacher is not confirmed: their gender does not match the class's audience. Choose another person.
refusAffectation.plafond: The teacher is not confirmed: this class would exceed their weekly hours ceiling. Choose another person.
refusAffectation.nonDisponible: The teacher is not confirmed: their availability does not cover all of the class's slots. Choose another person.
refusAffectation.chevauchementClasse: The teacher is not confirmed: this person already has a class or a student at the same time. Choose another person.
refusAffectation.chevauchementSeance: The teacher is not confirmed: this person already has a session planned at the same time. Choose another person.

plafondClasses(plural, param=n).one: The teacher is not confirmed: they already hold {n} active class, for a maximum of {maximum}. Close one of their classes, or raise the maximum in the Rules. Otherwise, choose another person.
plafondClasses(plural, param=n).other: The teacher is not confirmed: they already hold {n} active classes, for a maximum of {maximum}. Close one of their classes, or raise the maximum in the Rules. Otherwise, choose another person.

refusAffectation.plafondClassesSansNombre: The teacher is not confirmed: they already hold the maximum number of active classes. Close one of their classes, or raise the maximum in the Rules. Otherwise, choose another person.
refusAffectation.inconnu: The teacher is not confirmed. Choose another.

regroupements.dejaAffecte: Another member of the management has already confirmed this class's teacher: your choice does not replace theirs.
regroupements.famillesClasseValidee: The families have been notified that their class is validated.
regroupements.contexteReparti: The students of these requests will be distributed according to the split below. You will then confirm the proposed teacher.

classesExistantes.one: {n} class is already open on this slot: the new one is added, none is changed.
classesExistantes.other: {n} classes are already open on this slot: the new one is added, none is changed.

liste.rechercheAide: Language, time zone or name of the class created
liste.aucunAvecCeFiltreDetail: Change the filter to see the other grouped requests.
liste.positionSemantique: Page {page} of {total} of the grouped requests list

diagnostics.intro: Each registered student waits for a first level before joining a class: this is where that placement is decided.
diagnostics.aucunProgrammeDetail: Publish a first version of the programme (Teaching > Programmes) before a placement can be decided.
diagnostics.erreur: The queue could not be read. Try again in a moment.
diagnostics.aucunDetail: All registered students already have a level decided.
diagnostics.manqueNiveau: The placement level is missing: choose it from the list of levels.
diagnostics.motifRequis: A reason is required, it is written in the audit log.
diagnostics.deciderErreur: The decision did not go through: {message}
diagnostics.journalisation: Each placement decided is written in the audit log.

qualite.intro: Teaching anomalies detected: missing reports, blockages with no follow-up, late assessments.
qualite.erreur: The anomalies could not be read. Try again in a moment.
qualite.aucuneDetail: Everything is up to date: reports written, blockages followed up, assessments on time.
qualite.traiterErreur: The handling did not go through: {message}

regles.intro: The default values for the whole platform. An exception for a specific profile is set from Operations > Individual rules, never here.
regles.erreur: The rules could not be read. Try again in a moment.
regles.erreurEcriture: The saving did not go through: {message}
regles.absenceSeuilDetail: Beyond this number of minutes without joining the session, the student is marked absent.
regles.dureeSeanceDetail: The length of a private lesson session, before any individual exception. A class has the length of its offer, or that of its audience (adults or children).
regles.dureeMinimalePayeeDetail: Below this length, a shortened session is still paid in full.
regles.pauseEntreSeancesDetail: The minimum time left to a teacher between two consecutive sessions.
regles.depassementSeance: Overrun allowed after the planned end
regles.depassementSeanceDetail: After a session's planned end, the room stays open for this time and the timer counts the overrun. After that, no one can join it.
regles.elevesParEnseignantDetail: The maximum number of students a teacher can follow in parallel.
regles.horizonAffectationDetail: The number of weeks ahead over which assignment looks for an available teacher.
regles.ageCameraAutoDetail: Below this age, turning on the camera stays subject to the guardian's agreement.
regles.ageInterfaceEnfant: Maximum age for the child interface
regles.ageInterfaceEnfantDetail: Below this age, a profile switches to the simplified interface when created.
regles.appareilsParEleveDetail: The number of devices a student can have active at the same time.
regles.seancesSimultaneesDetail: The number of sessions the same profile can follow at the same time.
regles.classesParEnseignantDetail: The number of classes a teacher can hold at the same time. A closed class and a one-off replacement do not count. A decrease removes no class already held. In their questionnaire, candidates choose from 1 up to this number.
regles.remplacementSection: When the teacher has not joined the room
regles.remplacementIntro: The minutes count from the session's start time. Each step comes after the previous one.
regles.remplacementAvertissementDetail: The teacher is warned that they are about to lose the session. Free teachers can offer to replace them.
regles.remplacementPerteDetail: The teacher is marked absent and can no longer join today's session. A teacher who offered replaces them, and families are notified.
regles.remplacementObjectifDetail: The goal: the replacement has joined the room.
regles.remplacementBornesAvertissement: Between {min} and {max} after the start. To go beyond {max}, first raise the loss of the session.
regles.remplacementBornesPerte: Between {min} and {max} after the start. To go below {min}, first lower the warning. To go beyond {max}, first raise the goal.
regles.remplacementBornesObjectif: At least {min} after the start. To go below {min}, first lower the loss of the session.
regles.remplacementOrdreRefuse: The order of the delays is no longer respected: another setting changed in the meantime. Close this window, then reopen the row to see the up-to-date values.
regles.entretiensIntro: Founders are ticked in Accounts, Management and Teachers views.
regles.regleFondateursDetail: When on, an interview cannot be scheduled, and a participant cannot be removed, with fewer founders than the minimum.
regles.fondateursMinimumDetail: The number of founders required among an interview's participants.

pause.intro: By default, each session of a class has a break, just after the middle. The timer bar offers it to the teacher, who accepts or declines. The teacher can also set their class's break.
pause.adultesDetail: The default break length of an adults' class. 0: no break. Rounded to 5 minutes, from 5 to 30.
pause.enfantsDetail: The default break length of a children's class. 0: no break. Rounded to 5 minutes, from 5 to 30.
pause.rappelDetail: If the teacher declines the break, it is offered again after this delay: the break is a right.
pause.resteDetail: The break is no longer offered if less than this amount of class would remain after it.

paie.intro: A month's pay is paid between these two days of the following month. Teachers see these dates on "My earnings".
paie.debutDetail: The day of the following month when pay payments begin.
paie.finDetail: At the latest on this day, the month's pay is paid.
paie.bornesDebut: Between the 1st and the {max}, the last payment day.
paie.bornesFin: Between the {min}, the first payment day, and the 28th.
paie.refus: These days were not accepted: they run from the 1st to the 28th, and the first day comes before the last. Nothing changed: choose other days.

fonctionnalites.intro: Features that change the behaviour of the whole platform.
fonctionnalites.erreur: The features could not be read. Try again in a moment.
fonctionnalites.erreurEcriture: The saving did not go through: {message}
fonctionnalites.multiParticipantsDetail: Allows several students in the same video session.
fonctionnalites.participantsMaxDetail: The number of participants allowed when multi-participant sessions are on.

protectionEnfants.intro: The officer receives, with the management, reports about a child's safety. Their name and email are shown to teachers who report. Leave the fields empty: the screen then says the management receives the report.
protectionEnfants.courrielDetail: The address to write to the officer.
protectionEnfants.videAide: Leave empty to remove the officer.
protectionEnfants.nomTropLong: This name is too long. 120 characters at most.
protectionEnfants.courrielInvalide: This address is not valid. An email contains an @ and a dot.
protectionEnfants.erreurEcriture: The change was not saved: {message}. Try again.
protectionEnfants.erreur: We could not read the officer. Try again in a moment.
protectionEnfants.representantDetail: The name shown in the legal texts. Leave empty: they then show "Rewayah Academy".
protectionEnfants.representantErreur: We could not read the representative. Try again in a moment.

conservationDonnees.intro: How long these items stay accessible before their automatic deletion.
conservationDonnees.erreur: The retention periods could not be read. Try again in a moment.
conservationDonnees.erreurEcriture: The saving did not go through: {message}
conservationDonnees.enregistrementsDetail: The number of days a session recording stays accessible.
conservationDonnees.documentsIdentiteDetail: The number of days a submitted ID document stays accessible before it is purged.
conservationDonnees.suppressionCompteDetail: The number of days of reflection before the management can process an account deletion request.

politiqueRevueKyc.aide: When this rule is off, any member allowed to review files can handle the files in their scope, whatever their gender.

evaluations.intro: What is planned, what has been taken, and the certifications obtained.
evaluations.erreur: The assessments could not be read. Try again in a moment.
evaluations.aucuneDetail: Schedule a first assessment for a student already diagnosed.
evaluations.aucuneAvecCeFiltreDetail: Change the filter to see the other assessments.
evaluations.manqueEleve: The student is missing: choose one from the list.
evaluations.manqueNiveau: The assessed level is missing: choose it from the list of levels.
evaluations.manqueDate: The planned date is missing: tap the date field and choose a day in the calendar.
evaluations.planifierErreur: The scheduling did not go through: {message}
evaluations.resultatErreur: The saving did not go through: {message}
evaluations.annulerErreur: The cancellation did not go through: {message}
evaluations.motifRequis: A reason is required, it is written in the audit log.
evaluations.journalisation: Each scheduling, result and cancellation is written in the audit log.

progression.intro: Each student's current level, their class, and the blockages or waivers in progress.
progression.erreur: The progress could not be read. Try again in a moment.
progression.aucunDetail: Students will appear here as soon as their first placement diagnosis.
progression.poserExceptionErreur: The setting did not go through: {message}
progression.clorerExceptionErreur: The closing did not go through: {message}
progression.manqueNiveau: The new level is missing: choose it from the list of levels.
progression.promouvoirErreur: The change did not go through: {message}
progression.motifRequis: A reason is required, it is written in the audit log.
progression.journalisation: Each exception set or closed, and each level change, is written in the audit log.

programmes.intro: The Rewayah curriculum, versioned: a published version can no longer be changed, any academic change creates a new one.
programmes.aucuneVersionDetail: Create the first version, still a draft, to start adding levels to it.
programmes.erreur: The programme could not be read. Try again in a moment.
programmes.creerVersionDepuisPubliee: Create a new version from this one
programmes.creerVersionErreur: The creation did not go through: {message}
programmes.niveauAucunDetail: Add a first level to start building this version.
programmes.ajouterNiveauErreur: The addition of the level was not confirmed: {message}. The technical code may already exist in this version: change it, then try again.
programmes.modifierNiveauErreur: The change did not go through: {message}
programmes.supprimerNiveauErreur: The deletion did not go through: {message}
programmes.publierVersionDetail: Once published, this version can no longer be changed. Any academic change will create a new one.
programmes.publierVersionErreur: The publication did not go through: {message}
programmes.champCodeTechnique: Technical code (internal use, never shown to the student)
programmes.ordreDeduit: The proposed order follows the last level of the chosen cycle. Change it if needed.
programmes.manque: Nothing was saved: {elements} is missing. Complete it, then try again.
programmes.motifRequis: A reason is required, it is written in the audit log.
programmes.journalisation: Each creation, change, deletion and publication is written in the audit log.
programmes.publierSansNiveau: Add at least one level to be able to publish this version.

contenu.intro: What the student can do at the end of the stage, and the time planned for each age group. The teacher, the family and the management follow progress from this data.
contenu.lectureSeule: This version is published: its content can no longer be changed. To change it, create a new version from this one.
contenu.objectifsAide: 3 to 5 goals, each written as something the student can do. Leave empty those that are not needed.
contenu.livreAide: The book where the stage is read. The pages are used to measure the class's progress.
contenu.livreRewayahDetail: For the stages read before the Mushaf. Its pages are not numbered yet: leave the pages empty.
contenu.mushafDetail: For the stages read in the Quran, from page 1 to page 604.
contenu.dureesTitre: Planned length and deadline, by age group
contenu.dureesAide: In weeks, counted from the student's entry into the stage. The deadline is entered: for each group, the sum of the stages must equal that of the level, otherwise the version cannot be published.
contenu.dateLimite: To finish in {semaines} weeks at most
contenu.limiteMoins: One week less in the deadline for {tranche}
contenu.limitePlus: One week more in the deadline for {tranche}
contenu.publierIncoherent: The publication did not go through: for {niveau}, the sum of the planned lengths or the stages' deadlines does not equal that of the level. Correct the stages' lengths, then publish again.
contenu.publierSansBases: The publication did not go through: this version does not have the complete foundation level (its four stages and their lengths). Create the new version from the published version, or pre-fill the foundation in an empty version.
contenu.erreur: Saving the stage is not confirmed: {message}. Check the goals and pages, then try again.
contenu.revisionAide: What families read in "Where I stand". Leave "Not set": nothing is shown.
contenu.revisionErreur: The revision could not be saved: {message}
contenu.manquePages: Nothing was saved: pages are written as whole numbers, the last after the first. Correct them, then try again.
contenu.proposition: Proposal to be validated by the management
contenu.propositionDetail: The goals and lengths in this draft are a proposal, not a rule: the management re-reads and edits them before publishing.
contenu.preremplirDetail: Adds to this version the four foundation stages, with their goals, their subjects and, for each age group, the planned length and the deadline of each stage (settings table). Review each stage before publishing.
contenu.preremplirVersionVide: To pre-fill the foundation, create an empty version: the proposal fills only a version with no stage.
contenu.preremplirErreur: Adding the proposal is not confirmed: {message}. Try again in a moment.
contenu.publierIncomplet: The publication did not go through: the stage "{etape}" is not complete. Open its goals and lengths: 3 to 5 goals and a length for each age group are needed.

journal.videFiltreDetail: Widen the period, or relax a filter.

journal.erreurSuite: The older entries could not be read.
journal.fin: You have gone back to the first entry of the log.
