observations.ligne: Visit {rang} of {date}, {tuteur} for {eleve}, {classe}, entry {entree}, exit {sortie}, length {duree}, {statut}
observations.fuseau: Times shown in this device's time (UTC{decalage}).
observations.indisponiblePhrase: Reading observation visits is not open yet in the app.
observations.videPhrase: Guardians' observation visits will be shown here.
observations.videFiltrePhrase: Widen the period or remove a filter.
observations.erreurSuite: The older visits could not be read.

suppressions.sousTitre: Deletion requests. The management handles them once the reflection period has passed.
suppressions.erreur: The requests could not be loaded. Try again.
suppressions.sansDonnees: The deletion requests could not be loaded
suppressions.refuse: This action requires two-step verification. Turn it on in Account > Security.
suppressions.indisponiblePhrase: This feature will be available once the server is connected.
suppressions.delaiEnCours: The reflection period runs until {date}. The request can be handled from that day.
suppressions.soldeTitre: A balance remains to be settled
suppressions.soldeDetail: {montant} remains to be paid. This balance stays due after the deletion.

seancesDetail(param=n).one: {n} session is planned. Cancel it or hand it to another person. The request cannot be handled while it exists.
seancesDetail(param=n).other: {n} sessions are planned. Cancel them or hand them to another person. The request cannot be handled while they exist.

foyerDetail(param=n).one: {n} student is in this guardian's household. Check their situation before continuing.
foyerDetail(param=n).other: {n} students are in this guardian's household. Check their situation before continuing.

suppressions.confirmerConsequence: The name, contact details and photo are erased. The person can no longer sign in. This action cannot be undone. Invoices and payments are kept.
suppressions.confirmerSolde: A balance of {montant} remains due and will remain so.
suppressions.traitee: The account is anonymized. The request is handled.
suppressions.dejaTraitee: This request is no longer pending. The list is up to date.
suppressions.delaiNonEcoule: The reflection period is still running. Nothing was erased.
suppressions.seancesRefus: Sessions are still planned. Nothing was erased.
suppressions.introuvable: This request no longer exists. The list is up to date.
suppressions.echec: The decision could not be confirmed. Check the list before trying again.
suppressions.horsLigne: Nothing was sent: there is no network. Try again as soon as it returns.

retraits.contexte: Accounts deleted by the management or by a guardian. During the retention period, an account can be restored. Restoring reopens the account, without putting the student back in their classes.
retraits.erreur: The deleted accounts could not be loaded. Try again.
retraits.sansDonnees: The deleted accounts could not be loaded
retraits.nonRestaurable: This account was deleted before the app kept its previous state. It cannot be restored here.
retraits.restaure: {deNom}'s account is restored. The person can sign in again.

classesQuittees(param=n).one: They had left {n} class: they are not put back in it. Add them to a class from Classes.
classesQuittees(param=n).other: They had left {n} classes: they are not put back in them. Add them to a class from Classes.

refus.aucunRetrait: This account is no longer deleted. The list is up to date.
refus.dejaAnonymise: This account is already anonymized: it can no longer be restored.
refus.etatAvantInconnu: This account was deleted before the app kept its previous state. It cannot be restored here.
refus.erreur: The restoration could not be confirmed. Check the list before trying again.

comptes.intro: All the people registered, those awaiting a decision first. A teacher with no ID document submitted stays visible here: this is the only place that shows them.
comptes.attenteUneAujourdhui: One person awaits a decision, registered today.
comptes.attenteUneUnJour: One person has been awaiting a decision for 1 day.
comptes.roleIllisibleUn: The role of a pending account could not be read: it is not counted anywhere and its nature is not confirmed. Reload the page to try again.
comptes.roleIllisiblePlusieurs: The role of {nombre} pending accounts could not be read: they are not counted anywhere and their nature is not confirmed. Reload the page to try again.
comptes.aucunAvecCeFiltreDetail: Remove a filter to widen the list.
comptes.erreur: The accounts could not be read. Try again in a moment.

attenteUne(param=jours).one: One person has been awaiting a decision for {jours} day.
attenteUne(param=jours).other: One person has been awaiting a decision for {jours} days.

comptes.fondateurRetire: {nom} no longer counts among the founders.
comptes.fondateurRefuseDirection: Only the active management can mark a founder.
comptes.fondateurRefuseInactif: Only a staff member with an active account can be a founder.
comptes.fondateurRefuseInconnu: The change was not saved. Try again.

retenusPage(param=n).one: {n} account chosen, of which {p} on this page
retenusPage(param=n).other: {n} accounts chosen, of which {p} on this page

retrait.tropGrand: A deletion covers {n} accounts at most. Remove some from the selection.
retrait.selectionRetiree: The selection is cleared: the list shown has changed. Choose the accounts again.
retrait.consequence: The person can no longer sign in, right away. A student leaves their classes. The account is anonymized at the end of the retention period. Until then, the management can restore it from People, Deletions. Invoices and payments are kept.

supprimes(param=n).one: {n} account is deleted. It is in People, Deletions.
supprimes(param=n).other: {n} accounts are deleted. They are in People, Deletions.

raison.compteDirection: a management account cannot be deleted here.

seancesAVenir(param=n).one: {n} session is still planned with this teacher. Hand it to another teacher, then try again.
seancesAVenir(param=n).other: {n} sessions are still planned with this teacher. Hand them to another teacher, then try again.

raison.erreur: the server could not delete it. Try again for this account.

retrait.refuse: This action requires two-step verification. Turn it on in Account > Security.
retrait.indisponible: Account deletion is not yet installed on the server. Nothing was deleted.
retrait.echec: The deletion could not be confirmed. Check the list and People, Deletions before trying again.
retrait.horsLigne: Nothing was sent: there is no network. Try again as soon as it returns.

comptes.plafondMessage: The server returns at most {nombre} accounts, and the list has as many: the most recent registrations may be missing.
comptes.detailsAbsentsTitre: Students' age, class and guardian not shown
comptes.detailsAbsentsMessage: The server does not give this information yet: its update is not installed. Students stay properly separate from guardians. Reload the page once the update is installed.

agents.intro: A token lets an AI agent open the app and read what a person reads in it. It can write nothing, cancel nothing, change nothing: the database refuses it, not the interface.
agents.libelleAide: Required. A token with no name is a token no one dares revoke.
agents.manqueLibelle: The token's name is missing: write what it is for.
agents.manquePersonne: The person observed is missing: choose one from the list.
agents.quiAide: The agent will see exactly this person's screen, and their journey will be theirs.
agents.chercher: Search for a name or identifier
agents.dureePlafond: Twenty-four hours at most, and the database checks it itself.
agents.identiteMasqueeDetail: The agent reads identifiers (ELV-0042) in place of first names. The substitution is done by the database: the first name does not leave it.
agents.identiteVisibleDetail: The agent reads first names, as the person observed sees them.
agents.pourraDetail: Open the app, navigate, and read everything this person reads.
agents.nePourraPasDetail: Write anything, see an ID document, a device, the audit log, or leave this person's scope.
agents.emisDetail: Give this link to the agent. It will not appear again: neither this screen nor the database can retrieve it.
agents.erreurEmission: The token could not be issued. Try again in a moment.
agents.revoquerDetail: The agent will lose access at its next request. This is final: a revoked token cannot be reactivated.
agents.erreurRevocation: The revocation did not go through. Try again.
agents.videDetail: No AI agent has access to the app for now.
agents.erreur: The list of tokens could not be read.

vue.contexte: The figures for {deMois}, each on its own: what is collected, what is recognized as revenue, what is owed to teachers and what stays on families' profiles.
vue.encaisseDetail: Payments received this month. A collection is not yet revenue.
vue.revenuDetail: Revenue recognized this month, excluding taxes collected.
vue.paieDetail: Estimated for the month: an upcoming cost, not a payment made.
vue.margeDetail: Calculated on teachers' pay alone, without other costs: it cannot be compared with a net margin.
vue.impayesDetail: Still to fund over the month's periods.
vue.essaisDetail: Students on trial, never counted as paying.
vue.soldesDetail: Money available on families' profiles: neither revenue nor margin.
vue.sansActivite: No financial activity in {mois}: the indicators are at zero.
vue.sansRevenu: No revenue recognized in {mois}: the margin cannot be calculated.
vue.evolutionDetail: One chart per notion, each with its exact numbers: collection, cost and margin are never mixed.
vue.graphiqueRepartitionDetail: Revenue recognized {deMois}, by type of student.
vue.etatPaiementsDetail: The month's profiles by the status of their period. A trial is never counted as paying.
vue.etatVide: No payment status returned for this month.
vue.topClassesDetail: The classes that collected the most {deMois}.
vue.dernieresOperationsDetail: The latest movements on families' profiles, most recent first.

alerte.aRegulariserMontant: {qui}: {montant} is missing to fund the current period.
alerte.aRegulariserSansMontant: {qui}: the current period is not funded.
alerte.sousMinimumDetail: {qui}: fewer students registered than the opening minimum.

pol.contexte: The academy's commercial rules, versioned and dated. A draft is prepared here and applies only once published, from its effective date. What protects families' money is not set here.
pol.dateEffetDetail: The draft will apply from this date, never to an invoice already paid.
pol.dateEffetReglable: Adjustable in the draft: it will be applied at publication, once the server is connected.

differences.one: One value differs from the active version: it is recalled under its field.
differences.other: {n} values differ from the active version: each is recalled under its field.

pol.aucuneDifference: No difference from the active version for now: change a field to prepare the next version.
pol.nonEnregistre: Your changes stay on this screen as long as you do not leave it: saving a draft is not yet available.
pol.sansBrouillon: No draft in progress: the values below are those that apply today. They can only be changed in a draft.
pol.erreurChamp: This field is empty or badly entered: enter a whole number, with no comma or sign.
pol.erreurCapacite: A class has at least one place: enter 1 or more.
pol.erreurTarif: A zero rate would make the class free: enter an amount greater than 0.
pol.erreurPlafond: The hourly ceiling is below the base ({base}): enter at least the base. These two values only apply to versions before 19/10/2026.
pol.erreurClassesMax: The maximum is below the target ({objectif}): enter at least the target.
pol.erreurMinimum: The minimum exceeds the smallest class ({capacite}): it could never open. Enter at most this capacity.
pol.erreurRemise: The discount exceeds the rate ({tarif}): the monthly fee would become negative. Enter at most this amount.
pol.prepaiementTrimestrielDetail: The discount for three months paid at once; the family sees it when paying.
pol.prepaiementAnnuelDetail: The discount for twelve months paid at once.
pol.cumulMaxDetail: The household discount and advance payment together never exceed this share of the price.
pol.parrainageDetail: Paid to each of the two households after the referred family's first month is paid.
pol.bourseDetail: Granted by the management on written request; it adds to no other discount.
pol.boursePlacesDetail: The share of students who can receive a scholarship at the same time.
pol.bourseDureeDetail: After this length, the scholarship is reviewed with the family.
pol.tauxEleveEnfantDetail: Paid to the teacher for each student present and per hour of class; an absent student is not paid.
pol.tauxEleveAdulteDetail: Paid to the teacher for each adult present and per hour of class.
pol.plafondEleveDetail: The maximum paid per student present and per hour. Since 19/10/2026, it equals the rate: no bonus is added to it.
pol.erreurMontantCentimes: Enter an amount greater than 0, with at most two decimals (for example 0.95).
pol.erreurPlafondEleve: The ceiling is below the rate ({taux}): enter at least the rate.
pol.dureeDueDetail: The minimum attendance for a session to count in pay.
pol.suspensionDetail: A month not paid on this date suspends access to class; the place is kept for the retention period.
pol.retractationDetail: During this period, counted from payment, the family is refunded what they paid, minus the sessions attended. The Cancellation and refund text shows this value.
pol.erreurRetractation: Enter a period from 0 to 60 days.
pol.erreurDureeDue: Enter a length from 1 to 240 minutes.
pol.erreurBourseDuree: Enter a length from 1 to 24 months.
pol.erreurSuspension: Enter a day from the 1st to the 28th of the month.
pol.tarifsDetail: The monthly price of access to a class, excluding taxes.
pol.tarifEnfantDetail: A child's monthly price for a class; it applies to periods that start after the effective date.
pol.tarifAdulteDetail: An adult's monthly price for a class; it applies to periods that start after the effective date.
pol.essaiDetail: A new profile's free sessions, before its first paying period.
pol.essaisDetail: Free for the family; after the last one, access waits for the first period to be funded.
pol.essaiActivationDetail: When off, a new profile starts directly with its first paying period.
pol.remisesDetail: By rank of paying household member, never rewriting an invoice already paid.
pol.remiseAucuneDetail: No discount: the first paying members pay the full price.
pol.remiseRangDetail: This member gets this discount on their monthly price; members already invoiced do not change.
pol.remiseRangSuivantsDetail: Each paying member from this rank gets this discount on their monthly price.
pol.enseignantsDetail: Per session, per student present and per hour, at the class rate: children or adults. An absent student is never paid; no minimum.
pol.baseHoraireDetail: Old minimum per hour, abandoned on 19/10/2026: the teacher is paid per student present.
pol.plafondHoraireDetail: Old maximum per hour, abandoned on 19/10/2026: only the per-student-present rate counts.
pol.occupationDetail: Rule abandoned on 19/10/2026: only a student present is paid, an absent one never.
pol.classesObjectifDetail: The recommended number of active classes: a guide, not a limit.
pol.classesMaxDetail: The maximum load advised for a teacher.
pol.internetDetail: One allowance per eligible teacher, never multiplied by class or by student.
pol.sectionClassesDetail: The size of classes and the threshold for opening one.
pol.capaciteEnfantDetail: The number of seats planned; it is also used for the teacher's hourly rate.
pol.capaciteAdulteDetail: The number of seats planned in an adults' class.
pol.capaciteDebutantDetail: Smaller, to follow each beginner closely.
pol.minimumDetail: Below it, a class does not open and the management is alerted.
pol.paiementDetail: The payment method and the length of time a place is kept.
pol.railWebDetail: The only payment method offered to families at launch.
pol.railMobileDetail: Planned for later: no mobile payment button is shown to families at launch.
pol.conservationDetail: How long a student's place stays reserved when their new period is not funded.
pol.relancesDetail: Reminders for an unfunded period, sent to the guardian or the independent adult in the app; never to the child.
pol.relanceApres: {jours} after the start of the period
pol.pilotageDetail: Guides for reading the figures, never rules that block.
pol.margeDetail: A guide for reading the overview, never a sanction, refusal or block.
pol.margeObjectifDetail: The net margin aimed for, all costs included: a steering guide, never a sanction or a block.
pol.margeForteDetail: The guide for a very good month; it does not go below the target.
pol.margeStretchDetail: The ambitious guide; it does not go below the strong performance.
pol.erreurMargeMax: Enter a margin of 100% at most.
pol.erreurMargeForte: Strong performance does not go below the target ({objectif}): enter an equal or higher value.
pol.erreurMargeStretch: The stretch scenario does not go below strong performance ({forte}): enter an equal or higher value.
pol.budgetsDetail: Non-binding: spending guides, never a block or a sanction.
pol.invariantsDetail: They protect families' money: they are not settings, no version changes them.
pol.invariantConfirmation: A payment is confirmed before any credit to a profile.
pol.invariantDoubleDebit: The same payment is never debited twice.
pol.invariantPeriode: Access to class depends on the funded period, never on the balance.
pol.invariantSoldes: Each profile has its own balance; the household total is only a reading.
pol.invariantIdempotence: The same payment received twice is recorded only once.
pol.invariantHistorique: The payment history is neither erased nor rewritten: it is only added to.
pol.publierConsequence: Publishing makes this draft applicable from its effective date; no invoice already paid is changed.
pol.publicationIndisponibleDetail: Nothing was published: the publishing service is not connected yet. The active version continues to apply. Keep this screen open to keep your changes, or come back when publishing is open.
pol.publicationNonConfirmeeDetail: The answer did not arrive: the request may not have reached Rewayah. Check the active version before trying again.
pol.publicationFaiteDetail: Rewayah saved the new version. It will apply from its effective date; until then, the active version continues to apply.
pol.publicationRefuseeDetail: Nothing was published: publishing prices requires two-step verification. Turn it on in Account > Security, then try again.
pol.publicationInvalideDetail: Rewayah refused this version: the effective date must be upcoming and after the last version, and each discount must stay below the rate. Nothing was published: correct, then try again.
pol.champsACorrigerDetail: An empty, badly entered or inconsistent field prevents preparing the publication: correct each flagged field as its sentence says, then publish.
pol.apercuDetail: What the draft would give on screen, recalculated at each valid change. These are examples: nothing is invoiced or paid.
pol.apercuFamilleDetail: The monthly fee of each paying child, in rank order, then the household total.
pol.apercuEnseignantDetail: What one session hour earns depending on the students present; an absent student does not count.
pol.apercuAttente: The preview awaits a valid entry
pol.apercuAttenteDetail: A field in the draft is empty, badly entered or inconsistent: correct the flagged field, the preview recalculates right away.
pol.apercuCapaciteAttente: This class has no place: enter a capacity of at least 1 student to see the example.
pol.apercuIndisponible: The preview is not available yet
pol.apercuIndisponibleDetail: The preview calculation is not connected yet: no amount is estimated here. The draft stays editable.
pol.apercuErreurDetail: The calculation is not confirmed: the request may not have reached Rewayah. Your entries are kept: run the calculation again.
pol.apercuHorsLigneDetail: The preview cannot be calculated now. Your entries are kept; run the calculation again as soon as sending is possible again.
pol.apercuRecalculDetail: The amounts below match the previous choice: they update as soon as the calculation succeeds.
pol.historiqueDetail: All versions, most recent first. Nothing in it changes: a published version stays as it is.
pol.historiqueVide: No other version for now: only the active version exists.
pol.sansDonnees: The published prices could not be loaded
pol.apercuPresentsDetail: Only a student present is paid; there is no minimum.
pol.apercuSansTaux: This version carries no per-student-present rate: the example applies only to a version that has one.

paieWise.validerIntro: Check with the teacher, by a means other than the app, that these details are the ones they gave. They enter the Wise file only after your validation.
paieWise.validees: Details validated: they will enter the next Wise file.
paieWise.erreurValider: The validation is not confirmed: the details may have changed in the meantime. Close, reopen the list, then try again.
paieWise.phrase: Prepare the month's pay file, import it into Wise (batch payments), then note each payment made.
paieWise.exportIntro: One line per teacher whose details are complete, with the month's remaining amount to pay set by the server. The file is prepared once a month; each preparation is recorded.
paieWise.moisPrecedentDetail: The month just ended: pay is paid before the 5th.
paieWise.moisEnCoursDetail: The current month, if an advance must be paid.
paieWise.aucuneLigne: No teacher has pay to pay this month with complete details.
paieWise.manquantsPhrase: These teachers are not in the file: remind them to fill in their details in "Receive my payments".
paieWise.modeleAbsent: The Wise template is not set yet. The management must first download, in Wise, the "Send to bank accounts" template as CSV, then pass it on so it is set once.
paieWise.erreurExport: The file could not be prepared. Try again in a moment; if this continues, the month's pay statement may be incomplete.
paieWise.noterIntro: Note a payment already made in Wise or by another means. The teacher sees it in "Payments received".
paieWise.montantAide: The exact amount sent, for example 25.87.
paieWise.referenceAide: The transaction number given by Wise or the bank. Never an account number.
paieWise.noteAide: Read by the management and accounting only.
paieWise.erreurNoter: The payment is not confirmed: check the amount, the date and the reference, then try again.
paieWise.erreurChamp: This field is empty or badly written: correct it, then note the payment.
paieWise.aucunEnseignant: No teacher to pay is registered yet.

pai.sousTitre: A payment received outside the app (transfer, cash) is recorded here, for a student. Their month is then invoiced, then settled if the payment covers it. Entered by accounting, it is credited after the management's validation.
pai.videPhrase: Registered students will appear here with what they still have to pay.
pai.montantAide: Pre-filled with the remaining to pay. Correct it if the family paid another sum.
pai.erreurMontant: This amount is not readable. Write an amount greater than zero, for example 50 or 50.50.
pai.referenceAide: For example the transfer number: it helps find this payment later.
pai.rembAucun: No payment to refund for this student.
pai.rembErreur: The refund could not be confirmed. Try again: it will go out only once.
pai.rembRefusePhrase: The payment provider refused it: nothing went out. You can try again.
pai.rembEnvoyePhrase: It will appear in the student's balance once the payment provider has confirmed it.
pai.rembSansRetour: The money goes to the payment provider, and this refund cannot be cancelled.
pai.rembRien: Nothing to give back on this payment.
pai.rembReglePrepaiement: Plan paid in advance: months begun are due at the normal monthly price, with no discount; the rest is returned.

rembRegleDelai(param=jours).one: Paid less than a day ago: what was paid is returned, minus the sessions attended.
rembRegleDelai(param=jours).other: Paid less than {jours} days ago: what was paid is returned, minus the sessions attended.

pai.rembPropose: Fair amount, calculated by the server
pai.rembMois: Months begun, at the normal price
pai.horsLigne: Nothing can be recorded for now. Reopen this sheet when the network has returned.
pai.ilManque: {dePrenom}'s month is not yet settled. It will be as soon as the balance is recorded.
pai.dejaEnregistre: This payment was already recorded: nothing was added.
pai.refusDroits: Only the management and accounting can record a payment. Nothing was recorded.
pai.refusInvalide: The amount, currency or student was not accepted. Nothing was recorded: check the amount and try again from the list.
pai.inconnuPhrase: The answer did not arrive. Tap "Try again": the same payment will never be counted twice.
pai.demandePhrase: The payment is passed to the management. It will be credited to {prenom} as soon as they have validated it.
pai.demandeDejaFaite: This payment is already awaiting the management's validation: nothing was added.

tarifs.phrase: Free access (nothing to pay) or a special price (a discount or a price per month) is granted to a student until the month you choose, with its reason. Open a student in the list below, then "Free access or special price". The month's invoice takes it into account.
tarifs.vide: No free access or special price for now.
tarifs.feuilleTitre: Free access or special price for {prenom}
tarifs.offertAide: {prenom} has nothing to pay until the end of the chosen month. Their access opens right away.
tarifs.reductionAide: A whole number from 1 to 99. The rest of the price is paid as usual.
tarifs.erreurReduction: Enter a whole number from 1 to 99.
tarifs.montantAide: The price the family pays each month, excluding taxes. It must be lower than the student's normal price.
tarifs.erreurMontant: Enter an amount greater than 0, for example 40 or 42.50.
tarifs.raisonAide: It stays in the management's log.
tarifs.erreurRaison: Write the reason, it is required.
tarifs.valeurOffert: Free access until the end of {mois}
tarifs.valeurMontant: {montant} per month until the end of {mois}
tarifs.faitPhrase: {dePrenom}'s invoice takes it into account from this month.
tarifs.refusDroits: Only the management grants free access or a special price.
tarifs.refusInvalide: A value was refused: check the discount, the month and the reason.
tarifs.refusDejaActive: {prenom} already has free access, a special price or a scholarship. Remove it first.
tarifs.refusMontant: This price is not lower than {dePrenom}'s normal price. Enter a lower price, or choose "Free access".
tarifs.inconnuPhrase: We do not know whether it is recorded. Reopen the list before trying again.
tarifs.retirerPhrase: {dePrenom}'s next invoices will return to the normal price. Invoices already issued do not change.

fac.moisSuivant: Next month, to issue before it starts.
fac.explication: Each registered student receives their month's invoice, at the published price in force, with the family discount. Credits already received settle right away the months they cover. An invoice already issued is never issued a second time.
fac.faitPhrase: Families see their invoice and what they still have to pay.
fac.dejaEmises: All of this month's invoices had already been issued: nothing was added.
fac.refusDroits: Only the management and accounting issue invoices. Nothing was issued.
fac.refusMois: Only the current month and the next can be invoiced. Nothing was issued: close this sheet and choose one of the two.
fac.refusSansPrix: No published price applies to this month. Nothing was issued: first publish the prices in the prices tab, then try again.
fac.inconnuPhrase: The answer did not arrive. Tap "Try again": an invoice already issued is never issued twice.

autres.intro: Internet allowance, bonuses and missions of this month, paid with the pay.
autres.vide: No other earnings for this month.
autres.attribuer: Grant a bonus, a mission or the Internet allowance
autres.feuilleIntro: This amount is paid at the end of the month with the pay. The teacher sees it on "My earnings".
autres.naturePrimeDetail: An extra sum, decided by the management.
autres.natureMissionDetail: Work entrusted in addition to sessions.
autres.natureAideInternetDetail: The monthly allowance for connection, one per month. The policy does not set the amount yet.
autres.natureAideInternetPolitique: The monthly allowance for connection, one per month. Policy amount: {montant}.
autres.libelleAide: What the teacher will read, for example "Replacement of 12 November".
autres.erreurLibelle: Write a label of 120 characters at most: the teacher will read it.
autres.erreurMontant: Enter an amount greater than 0, for example 25 or 12.50.
autres.erreurEnvoi: The grant is not confirmed: the request may not have reached Rewayah. Try again: nothing will be granted twice.
autres.erreurLecture: The other earnings could not be read: the request may not have reached Rewayah. Try again.
autres.erreurAnnulation: The cancellation is not confirmed: the request may not have reached Rewayah. Try again: nothing will be cancelled twice.
autres.annulerPhrase: "{libelle}" will not be paid. The line stays in the management's history.

planning.sousTitre: The week's sessions, all classes together, day by day.
planning.videDetail: Sessions appear here as soon as a class has a timetable this week. Try another week.
planning.sansDonnees: The planning could not be loaded
planning.erreur: The planning could not be read: the read may not have reached Rewayah. Try again in a moment.
planning.indisponiblePhrase: The planning will be shown here once the server is connected. Until then, nothing is shown: no session is invented.

remplacement.absenceSansRemplacant: Absence declared by the teacher, no replacement
remplacement.remplaceParHorsGenre: Replaced by {nom}, outside the class's gender (management's choice)
remplacement.action: Assign a replacement for this {deClasse} session
remplacement.contexte: Only teachers free at the exact time of the session are offered. Those of the class's gender come first.

reaffecter.horsLigne: No connection: the decision will be made once the device is reconnected.

reaffecter.dejaEnPlace: {nom} already takes this class: nothing was changed.
reaffecter.refusOccupe: This teacher is no longer free at the class's times: the list was read again. Choose another teacher.
reaffecter.refusIncompatible: This teacher cannot take over this class (account, language, audience or number of classes): the list was read again. Choose another teacher.
reaffecter.refusClasse: This class is no longer active or has no teacher: nothing was changed.
reaffecter.erreur: The decision is not confirmed: the request may not have reached Rewayah. Try again in a moment.

fusion.aucuneCibleDetail: A class at the same timetable and in the same category is needed, with room for all of this class's students.
fusion.erreurCibles: The parallel classes could not be read. Try again in a moment.
fusion.sansDonneesCibles: The list of parallel classes could not be loaded
fusion.apercuErreur: The merge preview could not be calculated. Try again in a moment.
fusion.apercuEnseignantLibere: {enseignant} no longer has this class and becomes free at this timetable.
fusion.apercuSansEnseignant: This class has no teacher: no one is freed.
fusion.apercuIrreversible: The merged class is closed, and the history of both classes is kept. This decision cannot be undone.
fusion.fusionHorsLigne: The merge can be confirmed when the connection has returned. Your choice stays displayed.

fusionFaite.other: Merge done: {n} students are now in {cible}.

fusion.manqueCible: The class that welcomes the students is missing: choose one from the list.

fusion.aucunEleveDetail: There is no one to transfer.
fusion.erreurEleves: The class's students could not be read. Try again in a moment.
fusion.manqueEleve: The student is missing: choose one from the list.
fusion.transfertHorsLigne: The transfer can be confirmed when the connection has returned. Your choice stays displayed.

fusion.refusAutre: The transfer did not take place: {motif}. Check the class, then start again.

tirage.sousTitre: The server randomly draws the session each reviewer receives. The management sets the rules; the reviewer never chooses their class.
tirage.sansDonnees: The draws could not be loaded
tirage.erreur: The draws could not be read: the read may not have reached Rewayah. Try again in a moment.
tirage.indisponibleTitre: Available once the server is connected
tirage.indisponiblePhrase: The draw rules and history will be shown here once the server is connected. Until then, nothing is shown: no draw is invented.
tirage.reserveTitre: This screen is reserved for the management
tirage.reservePhrase: Your account does not have access to the draws: they are reserved for the management, so that no one can predict who will be reviewed. If you need them, ask the management for access.
tirage.reglesIntro: These rules apply to the next draws. Missions already assigned do not change. Each save creates a new version; the old ones are kept and never changed, and each is written in the audit log.
tirage.frequenceDetail: The number of missions a reviewer receives per week, at most: from 0 to 50. The server applies this number.
tirage.zeroPhrase: With 0, no session is drawn for review.
tirage.nombreInvalide: Enter a whole number from 0 to 50, or choose one of the values offered.
tirage.enregistreesVersion: Rules saved, version {n}. They apply to the next draws.
tirage.ponderationDetail: The higher the weight, the more likely these sessions are to be drawn. The draw stays unpredictable for the teacher and for the reviewer.
tirage.ciblesDetail: A target is drawn first when its session is live. It is never announced to the reviewer or the teacher.
tirage.aucuneCible: No target: all live sessions have the same chances, apart from the weight.
tirage.ajouterContexte: Choose the class or teacher to draw first. The target is added to the rules, which you then save.
tirage.manqueCible: The target is missing: choose one from the list.
tirage.aucunCandidat: No class or teacher to target
tirage.aucunCandidatDetail: All classes and teachers are already targeted, or no session exists yet.
tirage.erreurCandidats: The list of targets could not be read. Try again in a moment.
tirage.enregistrees: Rules saved. They apply to the next draws.
tirage.nonConfirmees: The saving is not confirmed: the server's answer did not arrive. Press again: the same request will be resumed, with no duplicate.
tirage.refusees: The rules were not saved: {motif}. Check them, then start again.
tirage.horsLigne: The rules can be saved when the connection has returned. Your choices stay displayed.
tirage.lectureSeule: You can read these rules, but not change them: changing them is reserved for a member of the management who has the right.
tirage.historiqueDetail: Each draw and each mission not reviewed are kept with their date. Only the management reads them: the reviewer sees only their own mission.
tirage.videDetail: Draws will appear here as soon as sessions are live.
tirage.aucunAvecCeFiltreDetail: Change the filter to see the other draws.

tirage.suivante: Next page of the draw history

bibliotheque.intro: Teaching documents: submit them, check their rights, publish a version, assign them to classes.
bibliotheque.brouillonAlerte: A draft gives no access to students or teachers.
bibliotheque.videDetail: Add a first document to prepare it, check its rights, then publish it.
bibliotheque.erreur: The catalogue could not be loaded. Try again.
bibliotheque.nonAutorise: You do not have access to the administration library.
bibliotheque.indisponiblePhrase: This feature will be available once the server is connected.
bibliotheque.introuvable: This document does not exist or is not accessible.

catalogue.videRechercheDetail: No document matches your search or your filters.
catalogue.pageErreur: The rest of the catalogue could not be loaded.

fiche.apercuAucunFichier: No file is submitted for this version.
fiche.apercuFichier: A file is submitted. Its rendering is checked at the "Check and publish" step.
fiche.apercuPublie: Published version: the content is frozen.
fiche.conflit: Another administrator changed this document. Reload the sheet before continuing.
fiche.echecEnregistrer: The changes could not be confirmed. Try again.
fiche.figee: Published and frozen version: to change it, create a new version.
fiche.retireRestaurer: It can be republished only after a new rights check.
fiche.nouvelleVersionOk: New version created as a draft.
fiche.nouvelleVersionEchec: The new version could not be confirmed. Try again.

classement.tranchesAide: A student sees only the documents for their age group. Tick all the groups concerned.
classement.tranchesAideLien: A link leads outside the app: the 6 to 9 years group is not ticked by default. Tick it only if you are sure of the site.
classement.tranchesAucune: Tick at least one age group.
classement.etapesAide: Link the document to the stages where it is used (optional).
classement.etapesVide: The stages will appear when the programme is published.
classement.etapesIndisponible: The stages could not be read for now. The document can be saved without a stage.
classement.depotInconnu: It is not possible to check for now whether file upload is turned on. You can already add a document by its link.
classement.ecoleTrop: The legal school's name is 80 characters at most.
classement.depotInactif: File upload is not turned on yet. You can already add a document by its link.
classement.videoLien: For a video, paste its link.

import.vignetteAide: An image (PNG, JPEG or WebP, 2 MB at most), optional. Without a thumbnail, the screen shows a cover according to the type.
import.completerLien: Enter the link address (https): an external link or a video requires it, and an external link also requires its description.
import.lienInvalide: This address is not accepted: it must start with https and lead to a site.
import.sansFichierAide: Nothing to submit for this type: enter the link address, then continue.
import.completerDabord: First enter the title, type, language and category.

formats.lien: This document is given by a link: no file to submit. A video is given by its link.

etats.confirmation: Sending finished, waiting for the server's confirmation…
etats.pret: File verified. Go on to the rights.

erreurs.taille: This file is too large. Choose a lighter file.
erreurs.type: This file type is not supported for this document. Choose another file.
erreurs.reseau: No answer arrived: the request may not have reached Rewayah. Nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
erreurs.refuse: This upload was refused: your account is not allowed to do it. Nothing was submitted. Ask the management to check your access.
erreurs.empreinte: The file received does not match the one sent. Try again.
erreurs.nonActive: File upload is not turned on yet: nothing was sent. Meanwhile, you can add a document by its link.
erreurs.creation: The draft could not be created. Try again.
erreurs.droits: The rights could not be saved. Try again.
erreurs.session: Your session has expired: nothing was submitted. Sign in again, then try again.
erreurs.stockage: The academy's file storage refused the upload. It is not your connection: it is a server setting. Try once more; if it happens again, this setting must be fixed before any new upload.
erreurs.envoi: The file upload got no answer, while the server is responding. Most likely: file storage does not yet accept uploads from this address, and it is a server setting; otherwise, the connection dropped during the upload. Try once more; if it happens again, it is the setting that needs fixing.
erreurs.service: The upload did not go through: the answer received is not the one expected. It is not your connection, and nothing was saved. Try again in a few minutes; if it happens again, the upload service needs checking.
erreurs.reglage: The file arrived, but the server cannot confirm it: its confirmation key is not the same on both sides. It is a setting to fix; trying again will change nothing.
erreurs.delai: Checking the file took too long and stopped. Nothing was saved. Try again; if the file is very large, choose a lighter version.
erreurs.vide: This file is empty. Choose another file.
erreurs.nonModifiable: This document can no longer be changed: it was published or withdrawn since this page was opened. Nothing was submitted. Reload the page.
erreurs.dejaDepose: This document already has its file. Nothing was submitted. To replace it, open its sheet and create a new version.
erreurs.expire: The upload request expired before the end. Nothing was submitted. Try again.
erreurs.contenu: This file's content is not that of its type: it is not a valid PDF, audio or image. Choose another file.
erreurs.introuvable: The file sent could not be found: the upload did not go through. Nothing was submitted. Try again.

droits.aide: No right is presumed: an unknown value blocks publication.

simple.intro: Choose a file: the app recognises a PDF, an audio file or an image by itself, and the upload starts at once.
simple.descriptionLien: An external link needs a description: say in one sentence where it leads.

acces.lectureAide: The document opens in the app and is not saved on the device. This is the default.
acces.telechargementAide: The student can save the file on their device. A file that has been downloaded cannot be taken back.

rangement.cours: A document from the academy, useful for classes. Shelved first in the Library.
rangement.plusLoin: Another document. Shelved lower in the Library.

simple.plusAide: Ages, programme stages, document source: nothing is required, the defaults are fine.
simple.aideFichier: Choose a file first: the “Save the document” button appears once the file is added.
simple.aideEnvoi: The file is being uploaded: the “Save the document” button appears as soon as it is added.
simple.aideLien: Paste the link address (https) and give a name: the “Save the document” button then appears.
simple.typeDifferent: This document expects a file of another type ({type}). Choose a file of that type, or add a new document.

refus.vide: This file is empty. Choose another file.
refus.video: This is a video: it is too large to be uploaded here. Add it by its link.
refus.inconnu: This file is not a PDF, an audio file (MP3, M4A, OGG) or an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP). Choose another file.
refus.tropLourd: This file is too large: {limite} MB at most for this type. Choose a lighter file.

vignette.aide: An image for the cover (PNG, JPEG or WebP, 2 MB at most). Without it, the cover is chosen by type.
vignette.echecSuite: The document can be saved without it.
vignette.tropLourde: This image is over 2 MB. Choose a lighter image.
vignette.pasUneImage: This file is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image. Choose another image.
vignette.retiree: Thumbnail removed. The cover is chosen by type again.

simple.aideNom: Give the document a name: the “Save the document” button then appears.
simple.aideDroit: Tick the right-to-distribute box: without it, a document that does not come from the academy cannot be saved.
simple.aideReglages: A setting needs fixing in “More settings”: the “Save the document” button comes back afterwards.
simple.droitTiers: The academy has the right to distribute this document
simple.droitTiersAide: Tick this for a document that does not come from the academy. Your name and the date are kept with this statement.
simple.nonEnregistre: The document is not saved yet
simple.enregistrementEchec: The saving of the document is not confirmed. Nothing is lost: the file is already added. Try again.
simple.reglagesMessage: A server setting is missing. Until it is set, no file can be added. A document can already be added by its link.

pourQui.tousAide: Enrolled children, teenagers and adults will see it.
pourQui.adultesAide: Only enrolled members aged 18 and over will see it.

simple.enregistreTous: It is visible to all enrolled members, children included.
simple.enregistreAdultes: It is visible to adults only.
simple.enregistreTranches: It is visible to the age groups chosen in “More settings”.
simple.bloque: Saving is blocked, and nothing has changed. What blocks it: {criteres}. Fix it in “More settings”, then try again.
simple.bloqueSansDetail: Saving is blocked, and nothing has changed. Open the document check to see what blocks it.
simple.inactif: The server does not have the update that allows saving a document yet. Nothing is lost: the file stays added. Tell the person who installs updates.
simple.fichierPresent: This document already has its file.

court.envoi: The file did not go through. Try again; if it happens again, a server setting needs fixing.
court.stockage: File storage refused the upload. Try once more; if it happens again, a server setting needs fixing.
court.service: The upload did not succeed. Try again in a few minutes.
court.reglage: The file arrived, but it could not be kept. A server setting needs fixing before you try again.
court.delai: The check took too long. Try again, or choose a lighter file.
court.nonActive: File upload is not enabled yet. Add the document by its link in the meantime.
court.reseau: No answer came back. Try again in a moment.
court.nonModifiable: This document can no longer be edited. Reload the page.
court.dejaDepose: This document already has its file. Open its page to create a new version.
court.introuvable: The upload did not succeed. Try again.
court.contenu: This file is not a valid PDF, audio file or image. Choose another file.
court.refuse: Your account is not allowed to make this upload. Ask the management to check your access.

publication.intro: Each point is checked by the server. Publishing freezes the version.
publication.apercuAucunFichier: No file is submitted: the rendering cannot be checked.
publication.apercuFichier: File submitted. Its rendering is checked in the reader for its type; the server says below whether it was tested.
publication.confirmerControle: I have checked the source and the proof of this version.
publication.droitsEchec: The rights review could not be confirmed. Try again.
publication.droitsFiges: The rights of a published version can no longer be changed: create a new version.

criteres.usageTelechargement: Download and reading without internet decided
criteres.renduTeste: Rendering tested in the reader for the type

explications.source: Give the original source in the rights review.
explications.titulaire: Give the rights holder, or the institutional origin.
explications.preuve: Submit the proof of permission for this version.
explications.usageApplication: Allow use in the app in the rights review.
explications.usageClasse: Allow display in class in the rights review.
explications.usageTelechargement: The server must be able to decide on download and reading without internet.
explications.expirationAttribution: The licence has expired or its attribution is missing: renew it.
explications.fichierSain: Submit a file: the server must scan it.
explications.renduTeste: The rendering has not yet been tested by the server.
explications.langueNiveau: Fill in the language and level on the sheet.
explications.versionEmpreinte: Submit a file to freeze the version and its fingerprint.

publication.aucunBlocage: All points are validated by the server.
publication.bloque: This version cannot be published until the server has validated all the points of the check.
publication.confirmerEffet: The version becomes immutable and visible to the classes the document is assigned to. To change it, you will create a new version.
publication.echec: The publication could not be confirmed. Nothing is half-published: check the sheet before trying again.
publication.pasDeCapacite: You can view the check, but not publish.

attribution.intro: Choose the classes that will see this published version. What you assign here is visible to their students and teacher.
attribution.epingler: Pin at the top of these classes' library
attribution.aucune: No class is open to assignment for now.
attribution.nonPublie: This document is not published. Publish a version before assigning it to classes.
attribution.erreur: The classes could not be loaded. Try again.
attribution.attribuerAucune: Choose at least one class before assigning.
attribution.attribuee: Document assigned. The chosen classes see it now.
attribution.attribueEchec: The assignment did not go through. Try again in a moment.
attribution.retraitIntro: A withdrawal hides the document from all classes. It deletes nothing: the file and history are kept.
attribution.motifRequis: Write the reason for withdrawal before continuing: it is kept in the history.
attribution.retraitConfirmerEffet: Classes will no longer see it, including those already using it. The reason is kept in the history.
attribution.retraitEchec: The withdrawal did not go through. Try again in a moment.
attribution.conflit: Someone changed this document in the meantime. Reload before continuing.

agent.intro: This page opens the app in read-only mode, with the token provided by the academy.

agent.indisponibleDetail: The request may not have reached Rewayah. Try again in a moment.

vide.aucunCoursDetail: Your next class will appear here.

lieu.consigneEnseignant: Choose the city where you teach. It is used to show your class times in your time, and the management checks it. Only you and the management see it.

lieu.chargeEchec: The city list did not load
lieu.chargeEchecPhrase: The list could not be displayed. Try again in a moment.
lieu.plusTardPhrase: You can still postpone this step. Until it is done, your class times are shown in this device's time.
lieu.obligatoire: This step is now needed to show your class times in your time.
lieu.echec: Your city is not confirmed. Try again in a moment.
lieu.disponibilitesPhrase: Your city changed time zone. Your availability keeps its exact times, but is now shown in your new time: review it.

parcours.intro: A few questions to personalise your journey. You will then only see the schedules and options that fit your situation.
parcours.erreur: This answer could not be saved. Try again.
parcours.indisponibleTitre: The questionnaire is not available yet
parcours.indisponibleDetail: The academy has not opened this step yet. You have nothing to do for now: nothing is lost, and you can fill it in as soon as it opens.
parcours.horsLigneTitre: The journey could not be loaded
parcours.horsLigneDetail: You can try again when the connection is back. Your answers are saved.
parcours.erreurChargement: The questionnaire could not be displayed
parcours.erreurChargementDetail: An error occurred on our side. Try again in a moment; your answers are saved.
parcours.introuvableTitre: This student profile cannot be found
parcours.introuvableDetail: It may have been removed from the household. Go back to the Household to choose a student profile.
parcours.finDetail: This time slot is noted as your preference. It does not reserve a place yet.
parcours.finAjouterDetail: Does someone else in the household want to learn?
parcours.ageRaison: Age decides the length of sessions and the number of students per class. We do not ask for a date of birth: age in years is enough.
parcours.ageAide: Choose the age in years from the list, as when adding the profile.
parcours.ageSansTranche: No class is planned for this age for now. The academy team can guide you.
parcours.langueQuestion: In which language should the class be taught?
parcours.langueRaison: This is the language the teacher will speak during the session. It is independent of the app language, which you can change at any time in your settings.
parcours.lieuRaison: We only use it to show you schedules in your local time. We never ask for your exact location, and this answer does not leave your file.
parcours.niveauRaison: Your answer guides the first suggestions. It does not set the official level: the academy assigns it after a conversation with a teacher.
parcours.niveauLettresAvecAide: Letters are recognised, reading needs help
parcours.niveauLectureCourante: The Quran is already read fluently
parcours.niveauMemorisationPartielle: Part of it is already memorised
parcours.objectifRaison: You can change your goal later: it guides the teacher's work, it does not commit you.
parcours.momentsQuestion: Which times of day suit you best?
parcours.momentsRaison: This answer creates no schedule and reserves nothing. It is only used to highlight, among the schedules the academy already offers, those that suit you best. You will see all the others just below.

f.memorisationTexte: What routines or activities work well to help students memorize surahs? I'm looking for feedback from experience: games, visual aids, repetition in pairs. Thanks for your ideas!
f.cartesTexte: I have been using repetition cards since the start of the year and they work very well, even with the youngest. I attach the template I fill in before each session.
f.niveauxTexte: How do you handle a class where levels are very different? I fear the most advanced will drop off while I go back over the basics with the others.
f.timidesTexte: A student refuses to recite in front of the others. I offer to let her recite first, when the class is still calm. Do you have other ideas?
f.ficheTexte: Each week I note the surahs revised and the points to go over again. The sheet fits on one page and helps a lot to prepare the next session.
f.heureTexte: The first minutes are often lost to setting up. I now ask students to prepare their page before the hour. What do you think?
f.reponseMariam: I use repetition in pairs and visual cards a lot. It really motivates the students.
f.reponseYoussef: Students listen again to the session's recitation at home: it helps a lot between two classes.
f.reponseSamira: Thank you for the template, I will try it this week.
f.reponseHamza: I sometimes let a student recite one-to-one at the end of the session, then in front of a single classmate.

A report will be shared after the session.

mentions.resume: Who operates Rewayah Academy and how to contact it.
mentions.intro: Here is who operates Rewayah Academy and how to contact it.

blocs: Rewayah Academy offers Quran classes by video, in stable Classes: the same students, a timetable that returns every week and an assigned Teacher.
A single address for your questions about the service, about these texts and about your information.
The service relies on technical providers: hosting of the web pages, the database and account sign-in, video for the sessions, private file storage and a payment provider.
Each legal text carries its version and its date, shown at the top of the page. When a text changes, the new version replaces the old one on the date indicated.

conditions.resume: The rules for using the service and selling subscriptions.
conditions.intro: These terms apply as soon as you create an account or register a student. Read them in full, they are short.

blocs: Rewayah Academy offers Quran classes by video. Each student is placed in a Class: a small number of students, a recurring timetable and an assigned Teacher.
There are two plans: the child plan, from 6 to 17 years, and the adult plan, from 18 years. No minor shall be placed in an adults' Class.
A Class opens when enough students are registered. Until then, you are on the waiting list and nothing is invoiced.
A child is registered and followed by an adult Guardian, who decides for them. See the Child protection text.
You shall give accurate information and keep your access to yourself. A session is entered through one's account, never through a public link.
Sessions take place at a fixed time, with the same Teacher. Being present and on time is part of the commitment.
A shortened session remains due if the student was present long enough. A session cancelled by the Academy or by the Teacher is replaced.
A quality reviewer may attend sessions without being seen, and a class may be recorded. If recording becomes real, we shall tell you beforehand.
The parent may silently observe their child's session.
Prices appear on the Prices page and in the app, when choosing a plan. They are in US dollars and exclude tax. The tax due according to your country is added to the payment.
The subscription renews every month. Discounts are calculated by the system on the household's invoice.
Payment goes through a payment provider.
There is no free trial. During the withdrawal period, which runs from payment, you are refunded what you paid, except for sessions already attended (see the Cancellation and refund text).
Without payment, the student no longer has access to sessions or resources. Their space stays open to see their profile, their history and to pay.
To stop, be refunded or pay late, see the Cancellation and refund text.
Everyone shall behave respectfully towards the Teacher and the other students, in words as in gestures.
How we use your information is explained in the Privacy text.
This part states the law that applies and the competent court.

annulation.resume: Stopping, being refunded, and what happens if a payment does not arrive.
annulation.intro: You may stop whenever you wish. Here is what is refunded, what is not, and what happens if a payment does not arrive.

delai(param=jours).one: The withdrawal period is {jours} day from payment, according to the pricing policy in force (Prices page).
delai(param=jours).other: The withdrawal period is {jours} days from payment, according to the pricing policy in force (Prices page).

s1.delaiSansDuree: The withdrawal period runs from payment. Its length is that of the pricing policy in force (Prices page).
blocs: There is no free trial. Instead, you may stop during the withdrawal period if the class does not suit.
During this period, you are refunded what you paid, except for sessions already attended.
After this period, the month begun is due.
The monthly subscription may be stopped at any time, without justification. It ends at the end of the current month.

After the withdrawal period, stopping a plan paid in advance, by the quarter or by the year, remains a right. Months begun are counted at the normal monthly price, without the plan's discount, and the remainder is refunded.
A registration during the month pays only the remaining sessions of the month.
A missed place is not refunded: it is reserved for the student in a fixed Class.
A session cancelled by the Academy or by the Teacher is replaced.
If the Class does not open for lack of registrations, nothing is invoiced.
Before renewal, you receive automatic reminders.
After the renewal date, a short grace period applies: the student attends their classes and the unpaid amount is shown to the Guardian.
If payment still does not arrive, access to sessions and resources is suspended. The space stays open to see the profile, the history and to pay. The place is kept for some time.
Then, the place is released to the waiting list. Returning remains possible at no cost, in a new Class.
The exact dates are those of the pricing policy in force (Prices page).
A student who reaches 18 moves to the adult plan at the next renewal. The parent is notified in advance.

litige.titre: 6. Disputing a payment with one's bank
blocs: If you dispute a payment with your bank, the payment provider takes the money back from the Academy as soon as the review begins. The access of the students concerned is then suspended during the review.
If the bank rules in favour of the Academy, access returns.
If the bank rules in your favour, the payment is treated as a full refund. The fees the payment provider charges the Academy for the dispute are added to your household's balance.
Before disputing, write to us: a refund request to the Academy costs nothing.
To stop or to ask for a refund, write to us giving the account name and the reason.

confidentialite.resume: What information we keep, why, and your rights.
confidentialite.intro: We keep only what is needed to run the classes. Here is what information, why, and how to control it.

blocs: Rewayah Academy Ltd decides why and how your information is used. Its contact details are in the Legal notice.
- To create an account: the name, the email address, the interface language, the country of residence and the time zone.
- For a student: the date of birth, which is used to choose the right plan and the rules specific to minors.
- Optional: photo, phone, address, level, timetable preferences.
- During classes: attendance, the handover notebook and the student's progress.
- To pay: the subscription and invoices. The payment itself goes through a payment provider.
- For a Teacher: an ID document, kept apart in a private space.
- Your agreements: the version of each text accepted and the date.
- Technical error reports, with no screenshot, no name and no identity.
- To form the Classes and deliver the classes.
- To follow attendance and progress.
- To invoice the subscription.
- To protect the students and review the quality of sessions.
- To repair outages.
A family sees only its own information. A child's information is never public and is never shown to other families.
The Teacher sees their students and their Classes. The management sees what is needed to manage registrations, Classes and payments. These accesses are enforced on the server side.
A quality reviewer may attend sessions. Sensitive accesses are recorded in a log.
Video goes through a specialist service. Access to a session is given by the server, for that session only and for a short time.
Today, the app does not record classes. If recording returns, we shall tell you beforehand why, how long it is kept and who can access it, and we shall ask for your agreement.
A notice in the room reminds that a review visit is possible.

We use a web page host, a database with account sign-in, a video service, private storage for files, a payment provider and an error reporting service. They process your information for us, for these reasons only.

To protect sign-in against bots, we use Cloudflare Turnstile (Cloudflare, Inc.). At the time of verification, Cloudflare processes your IP address and technical information about your browser, solely for this check and without any advertising cookie. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in securing the service.
We keep each type of information for the time needed, no longer. A Teacher's ID document is deleted at the end of a fixed period. A deletion may be frozen in the event of a dispute.
- To see the information we hold about you.
- To correct it.
- To ask for its deletion or to limit its use.
Write to us. We first check that it is you, or the student's Guardian. You may also contact the data protection authority of your country.
Access rules are enforced by the server. ID documents are in a private space, separate from photos. No protection is absolute: if you see a problem, write to us.
A child's information is given and managed by their Guardian. See the Child protection text.

cookies.resume: What the app and the website keep on your device.
cookies.intro: The app and the website keep little on your device. Here is what.

blocs: A cookie or a piece of local data is a small item kept by your browser or your device. It helps a service recognize you or remember a setting.
- Your sign-in session.
- Your display preferences, such as language and theme.
- A limited cache, which you can clear.
- On a student's device, their personal code, which never leaves the device.
These items are necessary for the app to work.
At the date of this text, neither the app nor the website uses advertising cookies or audience measurement.
When the app crashes, a technical report may be sent to an error tracking service. It contains no screenshot, no name and no identity.
You may clear the site's data in your browser settings, or sign out from the Account. You will then have to sign in again and redo your display settings.
If you leave Rewayah Academy for another service, for example payment, that service applies its own rules.

enfants.intro: Minor students take their classes under an adult's responsibility. Here are the rules we apply and how to raise a concern with us.

blocs: A child shall not access classes without an authorized adult Guardian. Registration, agreements and payments are the Guardian's responsibility.
The child plan runs from 6 to 17 years. No minor shall be placed in an adults' Class.
From 6 to 9 years, the Guided interface is on by default: simpler screens, with large keys.
The child takes their classes with a small number of students and the same assigned Teacher.
There is no public link to a room. A room is entered through one's account, with access given by the server.
The parent may silently observe their child's class. The child concerned is informed.
A quality reviewer may attend sessions. A notice in the room reminds of this.
A class may be recorded. Today, this is not the case, and the Guardian would be informed beforehand.
Teachers sign a contract and a review policy. Their ID document is kept in a private space, separate from the photos visible in class.
A child's information is neither public nor visible to other families.
The student's personal code stays on their device.
See also the Privacy text.
If something worries you, write to us. Say what you saw, when, and in which Class.
In case of immediate danger, first contact the emergency services of your country.
