lien.dejaServiDetail: A sign-in link works only once, and only for a short time. Ask for a new one: enter your email address on the sign-in page.
lien.autreNavigateurDetail: This link only opens in the browser where you entered your address. Open it in that same browser, or request a new one here: enter your email address on the sign-in page.
lien.autreNavigateurTitre: Open this link in the same browser
lien.refuseDetail: This link could not open your session. Ask for a new one: enter your email address on the sign-in page. If it keeps happening, write to the academy.

messages.intro: The management has passed on these messages about {prenom}.
messages.introSoi: The management has passed on these messages to you.
messages.erreur: The academy messages could not be read: the request may not have reached Rewayah. Try again in a moment.

notifications.message: The management has passed on a message to you.
notifications.messageEnfant: The management has passed on a message about {prenom}.
notifications.messageSoi: The management has passed on a message to you.

regles.nonTenueDetail: If no teacher has joined the room by this deadline, the session is postponed: the class is notified and the management sets the new date in the schedule.
regles.bornesObjectif: Between {min} and {max} after the start. To go beyond {max}, first lengthen the session not held.

notifications.seanceReportee: A session did not take place: it is postponed. New date to come.
notifications.seanceReporteeQuand: The session of {quand} did not take place: it is postponed. New date to come.

salle.reportee: No teacher joined the room in time: the session is postponed. New date to come, the class will be notified.

planning.intro: No teacher joined the room in time. Set the new date of each session: it will be held with the class teacher.
planning.erreurLecture: The postponed sessions could not be loaded: the request may not have reached Rewayah. Try again in a moment.
planning.feuilleContexte: The new session is held with {enseignant}, the class teacher, and lasts {minutes} minutes, like the postponed session. The class is notified of the new date.
planning.feuilleContexteSansNom: The new session is held with the class teacher and lasts {minutes} minutes, like the postponed session. The class is notified of the new date.
planning.choixManquant: Choose the day and time of the new session.
planning.horsLigne: No connection: the date will be set once the device is reconnected.
planning.fixee: New date set: {quand}. The class is notified.
planning.refusChevauchement: The date is not set: the teacher already has a session at that time. Choose another time or day.
planning.refusChevauchementNomme: The date is not set: the teacher already has a session of class {classe} on {quand}. Choose another time or day.
planning.refusChevauchementDate: The date is not set: the teacher already has a session on {quand}. Choose another time or day.
planning.refusDatePassee: The date is not set: that time has already passed. Choose an upcoming day and time.
planning.refusDejaFixee: The new date for this session is already set, perhaps from another device. Close this window: the session is in the schedule.
planning.refusClasseClose: The date is not set: the class is closed. No session can be planned in it any more.
planning.refusNonAutorisee: The date is not set: this account cannot set a date. Sign in with a management account.
planning.erreur: The date is not confirmed: the request may not have reached Rewayah. Try again in a moment.

salle.titulaireEntre: The class teacher joined the room first: the replacement is no longer needed. Thank you for being ready.
salle.remplacantEntreTitre: A replacement has taken the class
salle.remplacantEntre: The replacement who took the class joined the room first: today's session is taken from you. You remain the class teacher.

notifications.avertissement: You are not in the room yet. Come in quickly: if a teacher has offered to replace you, you lose access to today's session.

avertissementMinutes(param=minutes).one: You are not in the room yet. Come in within the minute: after that, if a teacher has offered to replace you, you lose access to today's session.
avertissementMinutes(param=minutes).other: You are not in the room yet. Come in within {minutes} minutes: after that, if a teacher has offered to replace you, you lose access to today's session.

regles.perteDetail: If a teacher has offered, they replace the teacher, who can no longer join today's session, and families are notified. If nobody has offered, the teacher can still come in: the session stays open to replacement until it ends.
regles.alerteDirectionDetail: If neither the teacher nor a replacement has joined the room, the management receives an email, once per session.
regles.avertissementDetail: The teacher is warned that they risk losing the session. Free teachers can offer to replace them.
regles.seanceTardiveDetail: A session created less than this delay before its start is never taken from the teacher automatically. The management alert is still sent.

payUx.repriseTitre: Did you leave the form without paying?
payUx.reprisePhrase: Resume the payment: a new form opens. If the payment already went through, nothing is paid twice; reload to see its status.
payUx.rassurance: Payment is processed by Stripe. Your card details go directly to Stripe: Rewayah Academy does not see them and does not keep them.
payUx.precedentOuvertTitre: The payment started earlier could not be closed
payUx.precedentOuvertPhrase: Nothing is paid twice and no new form opens. Try again in a moment: if that payment has just gone through, it will appear in your payments.
payUx.refus: The payment did not go through: some card information is probably incomplete or refused. Check it, then press "Pay" again. Nothing was paid.

cahierC1.onReprendPage: We pick up again at page {page}

cahierC3.arretPage: The class stopped at page {page} of the Mushaf.
cahierC3.arretAide: This is the last page shown in the room. If it is right, confirm; otherwise, correct it.
cahierC3.renforcerAide: Tap only the stage objective this student must reinforce. The rest counts as "as planned".
cahierC3.pretBilanDetail: The administration schedules the short assessment; nothing is automatic.

cahierSourates.aide: Tick a surah only if this student recited it from memory, without a single word wrong. A ticked surah is validated.
cahierSourates.toutes: All the foundation surahs are validated.
cahierSourates.retirerAide: A surah you validated can be removed for 24 hours.
cahierSourates.retirerConsequence: It will no longer count as validated for this student.
cahierSourates.retirerRefus: The 24-hour delay has passed: only the management can still remove it.
cahierSourates.retirerEchec: The surah was not removed. Try again.

souratesRetirables.aide: The surahs validated in this class that you can remove.
souratesRetirables.vide: No validated surah to remove in this class.
souratesRetirables.erreur: The surahs of this class could not be read. Try again.

accueilHoraire.demandeDetail: We will let you know as soon as a time slot opens for {prenom}.
accueilHoraire.erreurEnvoi: Your request was not confirmed. Try again in a moment.

importFormulaires.intro: The import is used to recognize people and pre-fill their application. It creates no account.
importFormulaires.lectureDroits: Your import rights could not be read. Try again in a moment.

acces.refusePhrase: Only the super administrator can import the application forms. Ask them to do it.
acces.doublePhrase: This import requires your second factor.
acces.doubleSuite: Tap "Sign in again": your session closes and you return to sign-in to use your second factor. Nothing was saved.

pas.liste: The eight steps of the import

depot.question: Which file do you want to import?
depot.explication: Choose the CSV export of the forms sheet (in Google Sheets: File, Download, Comma-separated values). Nothing is sent before "Analyze the file".
depot.carteDescription: The file is read on this device. It goes to Rewayah only when you tap "Analyze the file". Maximum size: 5 MB.

lignesLues(param=n).one: {n} row of answers in this file
lignesLues(param=n).other: {n} rows of answers in this file

noms.titre: This file will be saved as
noms.aide: These two names are used to recognize each answer. If you replay the same corrected file later, keep exactly the same names: no answer will be added twice.
noms.ongletManquant: The file name does not give the tab. Enter it to continue.
noms.invalide: A name cannot be empty, exceed 200 characters or contain the vertical bar. Correct it to continue.

depot.manqueFichier: First choose a file so it can be analyzed.
depot.analyseEnCours: Rewayah is reading your file. Nothing is saved yet.
depot.horsLigne: The analysis can be done when the connection returns.
depot.vide: This file contains no row to import.
depot.videAide: Check that you exported the right sheet.

fichier.illisibleLigne: This file could not be read, row {ligne}: {cause}.
fichier.illisible: This file could not be read: {cause}.

cause.guillemetNonFerme: an opening quotation mark is never closed
cause.malForme: the formatting is not that of a CSV export
cause.inconnue: its content is not that of a CSV export

fichier.quoiFaire: Export the sheet as CSV again from Google Sheets, then choose the file.

colonnes.dejaAssocie: Currently read in column {n}. Choosing it here removes it from that column.
colonnes.question: Does each column really contain what Rewayah thinks?
colonnes.explication: Rewayah recognizes each column by its title. Tap a column to change what it contains.
colonnes.nonLueAide: This column is not used by the import.
colonnes.nePasLireAide: Its content is ignored by the import.
colonnes.ambigu: Several columns carry the title of: {champs}. Tap the one to read, then choose what it contains.

libelles.texte: Multiple-choice answers (gender, languages, memorization level, possible start) are read using Rewayah's table of labels. A label that is not in it is flagged row by row, at the "Errors" step.

colonnes.relecture: Your corrections require the file to be read again before continuing.

doublons.question: Do these rows come from the same person?
doublons.explication: When rows share an email or a phone number, Rewayah proposes them as one person. Without your choice, the most recent row is kept and the others stay in the history. Nothing is deleted.
doublons.aucun: No probable duplicate in this file.
doublons.aucunAide: No row shares an email or a phone number with another.
doublons.tranches: Choices made by you: {choisis} of {total}. For the others, the most recent row is kept.
doublons.choisirLigne: Choose the row to keep, or say these are different people.
doublons.ouvrir: See the choices for this case
doublons.fermer: Close the choices for this case

etat.base: The row already saved is kept

recente.description: The other rows stay in the history, nothing is deleted. This is what Rewayah does without your choice.

base.description: A previous import already kept a row for this person. The rows in this file stay in the history.

enregistre.distinctes: You already said these are different people.
enregistre.ligne: You already chose the row to keep for this person.

ligne.description: This row becomes the person's answer. The others go into the history.

distinctes.description: Choose this if these rows come from different people who share a contact. Each keeps their answer.
distinctes.exemple: two people from the same family who answered with the same number

analyse.echec: The analysis did not go through.
analyse.echecPhrase: Nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
analyse.refus: The server cannot read this file with these names. Check the workbook, the tab and the file, then try again.

apercu.question: Is this the right file?
apercu.explication: Here is what Rewayah read. Nothing is saved yet.
apercu.contactsMasques: Contacts are hidden in the preview.

autres(param=n).one: {n} other row is not shown here.
autres(param=n).other: {n} other rows are not shown here.

apercu.sansLignes: The rows will be read as soon as the columns are matched.
apercu.ambigu: Several columns carry the title of: {champs}. Say which one to read, at the next step.
apercu.aideMarques: "Email to obtain": no valid email, the person cannot be invited. "Country code to confirm": the phone has no recognized country code. "Ignored": empty or repeated row.

champ.horodatageAide: Used to recognize the answer if you replay the file.
champ.genreAide: Used to file the answer on the right side. Never shown in the preview.
champ.nomAide: Used to recognize the person. Never shown here.
champ.telephoneAide: With the country code. Never completed or guessed.
champ.languesExplicationAide: The languages in which the person can explain and correct.
champ.memorisationAide: A declaration, not a finding: the level is established at the interview.
champ.ijazaAide: What the person can show at the interview.
champ.creneauxAide: Kept as they are, without a day. Never read as availability.
champ.heuresAide: Converted into a number of classes wanted.
champ.whatsapp: Agreement to be contacted on WhatsApp
champ.courrielAide: Used to recognize the person when they sign up. Never shown here.

controle.question: Are there rows to correct?
controle.explication: A row to correct is not imported. Correct it in the workbook, export the file again, then replay the import: rows already imported are not added twice.
controle.aucune: No error or warning in this file.

aCorriger.aide: These rows will not be imported.

avertissements.aide: These rows are imported, with a point to check.

ignorees.aide: Empty rows or rows repeated identically.

motif.horodatageIllisible: the date of the answer is unreadable
motif.memeReferenceContenuDifferent: same answer date as another row, but different content
motif.genreChangeSurLigneSuivie: the gender changed while the person is being followed: it fixes their side
motif.inscription1210: already known from the registrations import
motif.inconnu: a point in this row needs checking

avertissement.formatNational: the phone has no country code
avertissement.indicatifInconnu: the phone's country code is unknown
avertissement.indicatifAConfirmer: the phone's country code needs confirming
avertissement.zeroNationalEnTrop: an extra zero after the phone's country code
avertissement.courrielMalforme: the email is badly written: it must be obtained
avertissement.langueMaternelleVersAutre: unknown mother tongue, filed under other language
avertissement.langueInconnueVersAutre: an unknown language of explanation is filed under other language
avertissement.arabeRetire: Arabic is removed from the languages of explanation (it is not a teaching language)
avertissement.libelleInconnu: a multiple-choice answer is not recognized
avertissement.ijazaDeclareeEnG: ijaza declared as memorization: memorization is for the person to fill in
avertissement.experiencePretTest: "ready for a test" has no equivalent for experience: for the person to fill in
avertissement.moinsDe3Heures: less than 3 hours a week: that does not make a class, for the person to fill in
avertissement.creneauxContradictoires: contradictory time slots, kept as they are

comptes.question: Are these the numbers you expected?
comptes.explication: Here is what Rewayah counted in the file. Compare with your own count before confirming.
comptes.nouvellesAide: Not known yet: they will be saved.
comptes.aCorrigerAide: Unreadable rows: they are not imported.

attendus.question: What count did you expect?

fichier2110.description: 440 rows, that is 409 people once duplicates are merged: the count noted in the workbook that day.

autres.description: You know the number of rows or people in your file. Enter it: Rewayah flags any difference.

aucun.description: You confirm by relying on the preview.

attendus.aide: A whole number. Leave empty what you do not compare.

comptes.choisir: Say which count to compare to continue.
comptes.saisirNombre: Enter at least one number to continue.
comptes.ecart: Difference with the expected counts: expected {attendu}, read {lu}. Check before confirming: you can still import.
comptes.accord: The numbers match what you expected.

confirmation.question: Import these answers now?
confirmation.explication: Review what the import will do. It cannot be undone from this screen.

resume.doublons: Duplicates: {choisis} cases decided by you out of {total}. For the others, the most recent row is kept.

garanties.titre: What the import does not do
garanties.texte: It creates no account, no invitation and no application, and sends no message. It saves answers used to recognize people when they sign up. Replaying the same file adds nothing.

confirmation.envoi: Sending. The import is confirmed only when Rewayah answers.
confirmation.horsLigne: The import can be confirmed when the connection returns.
confirmation.nonConfirme: The import is not confirmed: it may not have reached Rewayah. Tap "Import the answers" again: the same request is saved only once.
confirmation.jetonPerime: The file or its settings changed since the preview. Run the analysis again to continue.
confirmation.choixInvalide: A duplicate choice no longer matches the file. Run the analysis again, then choose again.
confirmation.cleReutilisee: This request cannot be replayed as it is. Run the analysis again to start cleanly.
confirmation.refus: The server refuses this import. Check that you are signed in with two-step verification, then try again.

rapport.question: Here is what the import did.
rapport.rejoue: This request had already been saved: nothing was added a second time.
rapport.sansCandidature: These answers create no application: they are used to recognize people when they sign up.
rapport.historique: Replaced by a more recent one: {n}

lignes.aide: Each row is recognized by the date of its answer, never by the person's name.

prevenir.contexte: The sign-up link is sent by email to the people in the imported forms who left an address and do not have an account yet. The same address never receives the message twice.
prevenir.message: The message recalls the date of the answer and the name of the form, asks the person to create their account with the same address, and says there is nothing to pay.
prevenir.delai: Messages go out in the minutes after sending, not instantly.
prevenir.groupes: Sending goes out in batches of {n} people at most.
prevenir.fermee: Online sign-up must be opened first: while it is closed, the link would lead to a closed page and no message goes out.
prevenir.vide: Everyone who left an address is already notified or already signed up. There is nothing to send.
prevenir.sansDonnees: The number of people to notify could not be loaded.
prevenir.horsLigne: Sending will be possible as soon as the network returns.

mis.one: {n} message goes out in the next few minutes
mis.other: {n} messages go out in the next few minutes

resultat.tout: No one is waiting for the link any more: everyone is notified.
resultat.pasDeuxFois: The same address never receives the message twice, even if you send again.

erreurs.nonConfirme: The sending may not have reached Rewayah. Try again: no address will receive the message twice.
erreurs.generique: The sending did not go through and nothing is confirmed. Try again: no address will receive the message twice.

invitationsPersonnelles.aucuneImportee: No form answer is imported yet. Import the forms first: without them, the codes would find no answer, and no sending is possible.

varianteA.one: including {n} person who received the end-of-October waiting email
varianteA.other: including {n} people who received the end-of-October waiting email

lienCopie.contexte: This person did not leave an email address. Enter the one they will use to create their account: it is saved on their answer, and the code works only with it. No email is sent: you pass the link on yourself.
lienCopie.echeance: Valid until {date}, once, with this address only.
lienCopie.copieEchec: The copy did not go through: select the link above, then copy it.
lienCopie.nonConfirme: The preparation is not confirmed. Try again with the same address: you will get the same code.

refus.ligneIntrouvable: This application no longer awaits a link: it changed in the meantime. Close, then read it again.
refus.adresseConnue: This person already has an address: their code goes out with the sending of personal codes.
refus.adresseRequise: Enter the email address the person will use.
refus.emailInvalide: This address does not look like an email address. Check it.
refus.dejaInscrit: An account already exists at this address: the person can sign in with it.
refus.adresseUtilisee: Another person already uses this address. Ask for an address that belongs to them alone.
refus.desinscrit: This address asked to stop receiving recruitment messages.

invitationsPersonnelles.contexte: Each person in the imported forms who left an address receives their own sign-up code by email. With this code, they create their account even if online sign-up is closed, and find their answers already filled in.

dejaInvites.one: {n} person already has a valid code
dejaInvites.other: {n} people already have a valid code

dejaInscrits.one: {n} person already signed up: an account exists at their address, no invitation goes out
dejaInscrits.other: {n} people already signed up: an account exists at their address, no invitation goes out

revoquees.one: {n} code withdrawn by the management: no group sending for this person
revoquees.other: {n} codes withdrawn by the management: no group sending for these people

desinscrits.one: {n} person no longer wants to receive recruitment messages
desinscrits.other: {n} people no longer want to receive recruitment messages

invitationsPersonnelles.rythme: At most {plafond} messages a day for this sending, and {limite} per sending. Still possible today: {reste}.
invitationsPersonnelles.vide: Everyone who left an address already has a valid code or an account. There is nothing to send.

plafond.one: The daily limit is reached. {n} person is still to invite: continue tomorrow.
plafond.other: The daily limit is reached. {n} people are still to invite: continue tomorrow.

invitationsPersonnelles.nombreChange: The number of people changed since it was displayed. Nothing was sent: check the number again, then send.

resultat.tout: No one is waiting for their code any more.
resultat.pasDeuxFois: The same person never receives two valid codes at the same time, even if you send again.

invitationsPersonnelles.sansDonnees: The number of people to invite could not be loaded.

rythme.one: To avoid ending up in spam folders, at most {n} message of this type goes out each day. The others wait their turn and go out by themselves on the following days.
rythme.other: To avoid ending up in spam folders, at most {n} messages of this type go out each day. The others wait their turn and go out by themselves on the following days.

jours.one: Everything should be sent within about a day.
jours.other: Everything should be sent within about {n} days.

file.rienEnAttente: No message is waiting its turn.

desinscrits.one: {n} person asked to stop receiving recruitment messages: they will not receive the link.
desinscrits.other: {n} people asked to stop receiving recruitment messages: they will not receive the link.

reglage.libelle: Messages of this type per day
reglage.aide: From 1 to 2,000. Messages tied to an account, a class, a registration or a payment always go out without waiting.
reglage.invalide: Enter a whole number from 1 to 2,000, without spaces.
reglage.echec: Setting not confirmed. Probable cause: the connection to the server was interrupted. Try again in a moment.

importDouble.suite: Tap "Enter my code": you enter the code from your verification app, then the import resumes here. Nothing was saved.

publication.texte: Your name, photo and country may appear on the Rewayah Academy public website. This choice is separate from your application: it changes nothing about its review.
publication.case: I agree that my name, photo and country be on the Rewayah public website.
publication.signature: Your name counts as a signature: {nom}
publication.retirerConsequence: Your name, photo and country will no longer appear on the public website. You can give your agreement again later.
publication.echec: Your choice is not confirmed. Try again.
publication.lectureEchec: Your publication agreement could not be read.
publication.nonPublie: The text of the publication agreement is not published yet.
publication.horsLigne: Your choice can be saved when the connection returns.

photo.requise: Add your photo before sending your application.

invitation.phrase: An alert on this device when your class changes or you are expected, even with the app closed. You can turn it off at any time in Preferences.

evenements.admissionRecue: A new admission request needs review.
evenements.demandeHoraireRecue: A new schedule request needs review.
evenements.signalementEleve: A report is waiting for your decision.
evenements.personneEnSalle: No one is in a class's room: find a replacement.
evenements.paiementEchoue: Your payment did not go through. It is paid in Payments.
evenements.remboursementEchec: A refund did not go through.
evenements.cahierEnRetard: A session's handover notebook is waiting for your information.

reglages.contexte: Receive an alert on this phone or computer, even when the app is closed. The alert gives no name: the detail is read in the app.
reglages.categoriesContexte: Turn off a category to stop receiving it on your devices. It stays in the Notifications page.
reglages.classesDetail: Session cancelled, moved or postponed, teacher absent, schedule changed.
reglages.remplacementsDetail: Session to take, teacher not yet in their room.
reglages.paiementsDetail: Payment due or failed, refund, dispute, payout details.
reglages.admissionsDetail: Admission requests, applications, schedule requests, ID documents.
reglages.suiviDetail: Reports, messages from the management, review missions.
reglages.appareilInactif: This device does not receive your notifications yet. Your browser will ask for your permission.
reglages.desactiver: Stop receiving them on this device
reglages.active: Done: this device will receive your notifications.
reglages.desactive: This device will no longer receive your notifications. They stay in the Notifications page.
reglages.nonPrisEnCharge: This browser does not receive notifications. Open Rewayah in a recent browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari) to receive them.
reglages.iosEcranAccueil: On iPhone and iPad, first add Rewayah to the home screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen), open the app from that icon, then come back here.
reglages.refuse: Your browser blocks Rewayah's notifications. Allow them in the browser settings for this site, then come back here.
reglages.ignore: You have not yet answered the browser's request. Tap the button again to see it again.
reglages.echecActivation: The registration of this device is not confirmed: the connection may have dropped. Try again in a moment.
reglages.compteNonAutoriseTitre: No device notifications for this account
reglages.compteNonAutorise: Device notifications are reserved for active adult accounts. All your notifications stay in the Notifications page.
reglages.erreurTitre: The settings could not be loaded
reglages.erreur: Your settings could not be loaded: the connection may have dropped. Try again in a moment.
reglages.horsLigne: Notification settings can be changed when the connection is back.
reglages.changementNonConfirme: The change is not yet confirmed: the connection may have dropped. Try again in a moment.

dansLesTemps(param=ecoulees).one: Within the planned time: {ecoulees} week out of {prevue}
dansLesTemps(param=ecoulees).other: Within the planned time: {ecoulees} weeks out of {prevue}

auDelaDuPrevu(param=ecoulees).one: Beyond the planned time: {ecoulees} week out of {prevue}, before the deadline
auDelaDuPrevu(param=ecoulees).other: Beyond the planned time: {ecoulees} weeks out of {prevue}, before the deadline

suiviPedagogique.erreur: The program stage could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
suiviPedagogique.attenteEntretien: Your stage will be set after the reading interview with the management.
suiviPedagogique.attenteEntretienTu: Your stage will be set after the reading interview with the management.
suiviPedagogique.attenteEntretienPour: For {prenom}, the stage will be set after the reading interview with the management.

classeErreur.message: This class's documents are not showing right now
classeErreur.invitation: Tap Try again in a moment.

rayonCoursVide.invitation: They appear as soon as the academy publishes them.

aucunResultat.message: No document of this type for now
aucunResultat.invitation: Remove the filter to see all documents again.

carte.lien: {titre}, external link, opens outside the app

programme.vide: The stage will appear as soon as you join a class
programme.datesEcoleVide: The academy's dates will be shown here

livret.vide: Your results, your reports and your certificates will appear here
livret.videTu: Your results, your reports and your certificates will appear here

tu.formationListeAttente: All classes for this slot are full. Your request is waiting for a place to open.

parent.quoi: What is recorded: each time your child leaves the app during a session, the time they leave, the time they return, and whether this absence made them leave the room. Nothing else: not what they do elsewhere, not their screen, not their image, not their voice.
parent.pourquoi: Why: to follow your child's attention during class, for you and for their teacher.
parent.qui: Who can read it: you, your child, the session's teacher and the management. Never the other students or their families.
parent.retrait: You can withdraw your agreement at any time, right here. As soon as you withdraw it, nothing more is recorded.
parent.sansAccord: Without your agreement, nothing is recorded and nothing changes for the class. A student who stays out of the app too long leaves the room, with or without agreement: that keeps nothing.
parent.caseAccord: I agree that {dePrenom}'s exits from the app during sessions be recorded.

adulte.quoi: What is recorded: each time you leave the app during a session, the time you leave, the time you return, and whether this absence made you leave the room. Nothing else: not what you do elsewhere, not your screen, not your image, not your voice.
adulte.pourquoi: Why: to follow your attention during class, for you and for your teacher.
adulte.qui: Who can read it: you, the session's teacher and the management. Never the other students or their families.
adulte.retrait: You can withdraw your agreement at any time, right here. As soon as you withdraw it, nothing more is recorded.
adulte.sansAccord: Without your agreement, nothing is recorded and nothing changes for the class. If you stay out of the app too long, you leave the room, with or without agreement: that keeps nothing.
adulte.caseAccord: I agree that my exits from the app during sessions be recorded.

dates.intro: The dates of the year, entered by the management each year. Only published dates take effect: a closure moves back the deadline of the stages concerned and sets aside the sessions that have not yet started on those days. Days are counted in Makkah time.

feuille.aideDates: Dates are those of the Gregorian calendar, entered each year: the app does not calculate the lunar calendar.

publication.phrase: During these days, no new session is created and the deadline of each concerned student's stage moves back by the same amount. Sessions that have not yet started on those days are set aside, not deleted; a session already started continues. Removing the closure before it starts restores the sessions set aside, unless the teacher took another class at the same time in the meantime. Once started, the closure can no longer be removed or shortened.

conflit.generale: A session is no longer under a closure but cannot be restored: the teacher took another class at the same time. Free them, the session will be restored the following night.
conflit.avecNom: The session of class {classe}, on {jour} at {heure} (Makkah time), is no longer under a closure but cannot be restored: {enseignant} has another class at the same time. Free the teacher, the session will be restored the following night.
conflit.sansNom: The session of class {classe}, on {jour} at {heure} (Makkah time), is no longer under a closure but cannot be restored: the teacher has another class at the same time. Free them, the session will be restored the following night.
